articles.title: Steve Kerr jokes about Stephen Curry's age and compares him to Michael Jordan: "30? 29?"
articles.standfirst: The Golden State Warriors coach highlighted the point guard’s form at 38 years old and explained why watching him play reminds him of his time alongside Jordan with the Chicago Bulls.
articles.summary: The Golden State Warriors coach highlighted the point guard’s form at 38 years old and explained why watching him play reminds him of his time alongside Jordan with the Chicago Bulls.
articles.body:
Stephen Curry is 38 years old, but Steve Kerr prefers not to look at his ID when talking about his performance. The Golden State Warriors coach was asked how old he would guess the point guard to be if he did not know his age, and he replied with a laugh: "I don't know. 30? 29? He's something special".

The joke came amid the praise Kerr has devoted to his player these past few days. The coach not only highlighted his form, but also made a very special comparison: watching Curry compete at this age reminds him of what he experienced when he shared a locker room with Michael Jordan on the Chicago Bulls.

Kerr finds similarities between Curry and Michael Jordan

Kerr knows well what it means to play alongside a legend. He was part of the Chicago Bulls during Jordan's second stint with the team and now, after more than a decade at the helm of the Warriors, he finds similar traits in Curry. He is not referring only to talent, but to the ability to keep making a difference even though defenses prepare specific strategies to stop them.

"Honestly, it reminds me so much of what it was like playing with Michael Jordan back then," the coach explained. He also noted that, night after night, it is surprising what Curry can do, regardless of the methods his rivals use to stop him.

Curry's secret to staying among the best

In another interview, this time on the Tom Tolbert Show, Kerr went deeper into the reasons that explain the point guard's longevity. For the coach, his performance is not the result of chance. Behind his ability to keep competing at the highest level is a constant commitment to physical preparation and endurance .

"I think it is very unusual to see someone like that. Players who can sustain it for that long usually share the same qualities in terms of total commitment to their physical preparation and their endurance," Kerr commented. In that group he also mentioned John Stockton, Steve Nash, and LeBron James, players who managed to maintain a very high competitive level during the final part of their careers.

The coach also focused on Curry's passion for basketball. His competitiveness and his desire to put on a show remain aspects that, in his view, are reminiscent of Jordan.

At 38 years old, Curry is playing his eighteenth NBA season and remains one of Golden State’s main offensive references. His coach’s praise carries added value: Kerr closely experienced Jordan’s time in Chicago and now watches from the bench as the Warriors point guard continues to deliver top-level performances

articles.title: Philadelphia 76ers vs Chicago Bulls: Where to watch Sunday's game and what time is the first pitch
articles.standfirst: The Bulls, at the bottom of the East, host the unstoppable 76ers at the United Center
articles.summary: The Bulls, at the bottom of the East, host the unstoppable 76ers at the United Center
articles.body:
Few stories better encapsulate the current divide in the Eastern Conference than the one that will unfold this Sunday at the United Center . In one corner, the Chicago Bulls , languishing at the bottom of their conference; in the other, the Philadelphia 76ers, currently tied for first place in the entire NBA.

The clash promises to be a reality test for the home team and a golden opportunity for the visitors to further solidify their credentials as contenders.

When and where to watch 76ers vs Bulls?

The game between the Chicago Bulls and the Philadelphia 76ers will be played on Sunday, November 8, 2026, with tip-off at 3:30 p.m. (2:30 p.m. Central Time and 12:30 p.m. Pacific Time). The game will be held at the United Center in Chicago, which has a capacity of 20,917 fans.

You can watch this game streamed on NBA League Pass, as well as on various local channels in Philadelphia and Chicago.

NBA Standings overview: how Chicago and Philadelphia are approaching today's game

The difference in context couldn't be more stark. Philadelphia comes in sitting atop the Eastern Conference with an 8-2 record, sharing first place overall in the league with the Los Angeles Lakers. The Sixers also lead the Atlantic Division, half a game ahead of the Boston Celtics.

Chicago, on the other hand, is having a forgettable start to the season. The Bulls are second to last in the East with just 1 win and 7 losses, placing them third to last in the entire NBA.

They are currently fourth in the Central Division, five games behind the division-leading Detroit Pistons. The most worrying statistic for home fans is their defense: having allowed 1,037 points in eight games and with a -144 point differential, Chicago has the worst scoring gap in the East.

Sixers vs Chicago lineups: experience versus rebuild

Philadelphia boasts a roster that blends explosive youth with a veteran heavyweight. Shooting guard Tyrese Maxey anchors the backcourt, supported by Jaylen Brown on the perimeter and Joel Embiid's presence in the paint.

Joining this core is 41-year-old LeBron James, who brings leadership and ball-handling skills, along with shooters like Kentavious Caldwell-Pope and Anfernee Simons. Young prospect VJ Edgecombe, just 21, rounds out a rotation with both established talent and future potential.

On the other side, the Bulls are betting on a much more inexperienced project. Australian Josh Giddey directs the offense from point guard, with scoring support from Norman Powell and Buddy Hield from beyond the arc.

The front row features young names like Lithuanian Matas Buzelis and Frenchman Noa Essengue, both just 19 years old, while Nic Claxton and Zach Collins share minutes in the post. It's a rotation with promising potential, but the early start has taken its toll.

Fight for the lead and danger zone

For Philadelphia, every win carries double the weight in the tightly contested top of the league: with the Lakers, Celtics, Rockets, Thunder, and Spurs breathing down their necks, the Sixers can't afford to slip up against rivals they're expected to beat. Maintaining their lead in the East and the Atlantic Division requires winning precisely these kinds of games.

Chicago, meanwhile, is already eyeing the bottom of the standings. Only the Milwaukee Bucks are below them in the East, and in the overall standings they share last place with the Clippers, Bucks, Kings, and Jazz. Reversing this trend is urgent before the season slips away from them in November.

What is the prediction for the Philadelphia 76ers vs Chicago Bulls game?

The context is stark: Philadelphia arrives as co-leaders of the NBA, while Chicago is one of the worst teams in the league, with a devastating point differential. At home, the Bulls can rely on the energy of their fans and the scoring prowess of Powell and Hield to make the game competitive at times, but the visitors' experience, depth, and solidity make the difference.

Everything points to a 76ers victory, who must continue to add points to defend their lead in the East.

articles.title: LA Lakers vs Detroit Pistons: Where to watch Luka Doncic today and what time the game starts at Little Caesars Arena
articles.standfirst: Pistons and Lakers, showdown of leaders in Detroit: Cunningham hosts a Luka who just keeps winning
articles.summary: Pistons and Lakers, showdown of leaders in Detroit: Cunningham hosts a Luka who just keeps winning
articles.body:
The NBA schedule delivers one of those matchups that mean more than just a regular-season game. The Detroit Pistons , who have become the big surprise in the East, host the Lakers , who lead the West.

Two trains launched at full speed cross paths in the Motor City, and here we tell you all the details of the game.

Where to watch and what time do the Lakers vs. Pistons play?

The game between Detroit and Los Angeles will take place this Sunday, November 8, at 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time (5:00 p.m. Central Time and 3:00 p.m. Pacific Time) , at the Little Caesars Arena in Detroit will open its doors, a venue with a capacity of 20,491 fans.

Nationwide, the broadcast will be carried by NBA TV, with local coverage on Spectrum SportsNet, Bally Sports Detroit, and FanDuel Sports Network; while you can stream it on: Fubo, YouTube TV, DIRECTV, Sling TV, and with NBA League Pass.

Preview: Lakers vs. Pistons standings and recent results

The standings photo says it all. The Lakers rule the Western Conference and share first place in the entire NBA with a record of 8 wins and 2 losses (80% wins), identical to that of the Philadelphia 76ers.

The Pistons, meanwhile, lead the Central Division comfortably and sit in third place in the East, just one game behind the top spot held by the Sixers and the Boston Celtics.

What stands out most is the Angels' offensive firepower: the Lakers have scored 1,220 points, the highest total in the entire league, with a +77 point differential.

Detroit, by contrast, builds its success on solidity: it has allowed only 814 points in 8 games, the best defensive mark among the leading teams, for a +75 differential that speaks to a very balanced squad.

The Lakers come in hot. In their last eight games they have only lost once, a thrilling 129-136 against Portland. Since then they have put together a devastating run to close out: 103-87 against the Clippers, 131-125 against Toronto, a commanding 138-117 over Miami and, in their most recent visit, 116-103 in Sacramento. This is a team that scores in bunches and has also learned to win through control.

The Pistons are not far behind, although their path has been bumpier. They opened the season by knocking off the Celtics and strung together some significant wins, including a 106-93 victory in Philadelphia. Their most recent steamrolling was a crushing 124-91 over Charlotte, but they are coming off a 106-112 home loss to the 76ers. They will want to wash away that defeat in front of their fans and against a high-profile opponent.

The stellar duel: Cunningham vs. Dončić

The biggest attraction is at point guard. 25-year-old Cade Cunningham, wearing number 2, is the engine of these Pistons : the American carries on his shoulders the playmaking duties of a team that has made defense its calling card.

Around him, Detroit has young pieces with enormous potential such as center Jalen Duren and versatile forward Ausar Thompson, as well as reliable shooters like Duncan Robinson and Kevin Huerter.

On the other side appears Luka Dončić, the 27-year-old Slovenian wearing number 77, a true beacon of an offense that overwhelms whoever stands in its way. He is joined by a luxury backcourt featuring Austin Reaves and Collin Sexton, while the paint is left under the responsibility of Walker Kessler and the veteran Kevon Looney.

The tactical question is served up: the Lakers' top-tier offense against the best defense among the Eastern contenders.

What's at stake at the top of the NBA standings

For the Lakers, every victory is pure gold in a brutally tight Western Conference: Houston, Oklahoma City and San Antonio are all sitting at 7-2 and breathing down their necks. Losing their footing in Detroit could cost them first place in the West and in the league.

For the Pistons, beating the NBA leaders would be a statement of intent. T hey are just one game away from the top of the East, and a win of this magnitude would place them firmly in the conversation among the conference’s top contenders, ahead of Cleveland (14th overall) in their own division and closing in on the Celtics and Sixers.

Lakers vs Pistons Prediction: Which team is favored to win?

The league’s best offense and one of its most reliable defenses collide. The Lakers arrive in overwhelming form and with greater scoring depth, but Detroit is playing at home, defends like few others, and has wounded pride after the loss to Philadelphia.

I expect a back-and-forth game, the kind that gets decided in the final quarter. Dončić's firepower tips the scales slightly toward the Angelenos, although it wouldn't surprise me at all if the atmosphere at Little Caesars Arena pushes the Pistons to pull off the upset. Slight favorites: the Lakers, but with home-court advantage as the great equalizer.

articles.title: Shaquille O'Neal trolls Angel Reese with her own celebration and leaves her visibly annoyed
articles.summary: Shaquille O'Neal playfully mocked Angel Reese during a reunion at LSU's college football game against Alabama on Saturday, November 7, 2026, in Baton Rouge, Louisiana.
articles.body:
Shaquille O'Neal playfully mocked Angel Reese during a reunion at LSU's college football game against Alabama on Saturday, November 7, 2026, in Baton Rouge, Louisiana.

The two basketball stars, both former LSU athletes, were among several prominent guests attending the game alongside actor Kevin Costner, former gymnast Livvy Dunne and baseball pitcher Paul Skenes.

While Reese was filming O'Neal on the sidelines, the NBA legend made her signature "too small" hand gesture, a celebration that had recently become a sensitive topic following the Atlanta Dream's WNBA Finals defeat.

Reese had used the gesture to taunt Golden State Valkyries players, particularly center Aminata Gueye, during Atlanta's 97-71 victory in Game 3, which gave the Dream a 2-1 series lead.

However, Golden State recovered to win the championship in seven games. During the Valkyries' victory parade, former NBA player Festus Ezeli also mocked Reese by displaying a shirt featuring her celebration combined with a crying Michael Jordan meme.

When Shaq repeated the gesture, Reese appeared irritated and swatted toward him, while O'Neal laughed and walked away.

Despite the reaction, the two have a longstanding friendship and mentor relationship. O'Neal has supported Reese since her LSU days and helped bring her into the Reebok brand.

The encounter was widely interpreted as friendly teasing rather than a serious dispute. LSU ultimately lost the football game to Alabama 31-13.

Both stars are determined to keep the Lakers strong and prove they have what it takes to lead the team.

articles.title: Stephen Curry takes Riley and Canon to 49ers game for a family Sunday
articles.standfirst: The Warriors star took advantage of the NBA break to attend the matchup against the Raiders, where he also crossed paths with rapper E-40.
articles.summary: The Warriors star took advantage of the NBA break to attend the matchup against the Raiders, where he also crossed paths with rapper E-40.
articles.body:
Levi’s Stadium welcomed a very special guest this Sunday, November 8. Stephen Curry arrived with his children, Riley and Canon, to cheer on the San Francisco 49ers against the Las Vegas Raiders, taking a break from basketball to enjoy an afternoon of football . The game also gave him a chance to spend time with E-40, one of the Bay Area’s most recognizable music stars.

Wearing a white T-shirt and cap, along with sunglasses, Curry enjoyed the game from a suite alongside his little ones.

49ers dominate Raiders with a convincing win

San Francisco also had plenty to celebrate on the field. The 49ers defeated Las Vegas 38-17 in Week 9 of the NFL season after building a 21-10 lead before halftime.

Christian McCaffrey opened the scoring with a rushing touchdown before adding another after catching a pass from Brock Purdy . The quarterback also scored on the ground. In the second half, an interception returned for a touchdown extended San Francisco’s lead and made things even more difficult for the Raiders.

Las Vegas tried to fight back with a touchdown from Brock Bowers but lost two fumbles at crucial moments. Purdy later connected with Jordan Watkins for a 37-yard touchdown pass, while Eddy Piñeiro added the final points with a field goal.

The 49ers' victory put a sporting finish on an afternoon Curry got to enjoy with his children. His next stop will be back in the NBA, as the Warriors host the Pelicans this Monday .

articles.title: Bronny James argues with a Detroit fan who was ejected during the Lakers' victory: "How much money are you making?"
articles.standfirst: The Lakers guard became involved in a heated courtside exchange during a 121-116 win over the Pistons, despite not seeing any playing time
articles.summary: The Lakers guard became involved in a heated courtside exchange during a 121-116 win over the Pistons, despite not seeing any playing time
articles.body:
B ronny James had a difficult night on the court in Detroit, but that did not stop him from becoming one of the talking points after the Los Angeles Lakers secured a 121-116 victory over the Pistons on Sunday.

The 22-year-old guard was involved in a heated confrontation with a courtside spectator, with footage circulating on social media showing him exchanging words with the fan.

The incident reportedly ended with the spectator being ejected, while Lakers personnel stepped in to prevent the situation from escalating further.

Although the available video captures Bronny's response, it does not reveal what the spectator said to provoke him. Toward the end of the exchange, the Lakers youngster could be heard challenging the fan.

"Can you run a mile? How much money do you make a year?" Bronny was heard saying.

The comments quickly attracted attention, particularly given the scrutiny Bronny has faced since entering the NBA.

However, without footage of the beginning of the argument, it remains unclear what triggered the confrontation or whether the exchange involved any comments about his basketball career or famous family.

The incident also unfolded on a night when Bronny did not feature in the game. He had returned to the Lakers after a one-game assignment with their G League affiliate, the Coachella Valley Lakers, where he produced an encouraging performance of 22 points and seven assists.

His impressive outing in the developmental league offered a reminder of his potential, but he was unable to translate that opportunity into minutes against Detroit .

articles.title: Acuff Jr., the rookie who is measuring up to Oscar Robertson and LeBron James
articles.standfirst: The Sacramento Kings player recorded 32 points and 10 assists against the Heat
articles.summary: The Sacramento Kings player recorded 32 points and 10 assists against the Heat
articles.body:
Darius Acuff Jr., the number 7 pick in the latest NBA Draft, was not among the top candidates to be Rookie of the Year . After 10 games, the Sacramento Kings rookie has completely changed the landscape. His numbers place him at the top of any "power ranking" of first-year players, being on the level of, or even surpassing, players like Cameron Boozer, Yaxel Landeborg, or Darryn Peterson.

One tremendous fact: only Shai Gilgeous-Alexander takes more shots than him. The Thunder player has taken 232 shots in 10 games ; Acuff 230 . And Tyrese Maxey is behind, with 210 in 11 games, the same as Victor Wembanyama, 206, also in 10.

This is nothing new; the latest from Darius Acuff Jr. is drawing level with two NBA legends, Oscar Robertson and LeBron James . He did it after his latest showcase with the Kings against the Miami Heat in the 108-114 loss. Acuff posted 32 points, 10 assists, and 5 rebounds in 39 minutes of play.

With that game, the Sacramento rookie joins Oscar Roberton (who did it in 1960-61) as the only rookies in history to record at least 250 points and 70 assists in their first 10 NBA games . Acuff has totaled 259 points and 74 assists.

In addition, with his performance against the Heat , the Kings player joins LeBron James as the only teenagers in NBA history to have multiple games with at least 30 points and 10 assists. James did it on three occasions, and Acuff Jr. already has two: his 34+14 against the Pelicans and the 32+10 against Miami. It should be remembered that Acuff Jr. is only 19 years old and will turn 20 on November 16. By that day, the Kings will have played two more games ( Orlando and Portland ).

articles.title: Jaylen Brown confirms zero relationship with Jayson Tatum before confrontation: “Nothing to talk about”
articles.standfirst: The Philadelphia 76ers star has no plans to reconnect with his former Celtics teammate
articles.summary: The Philadelphia 76ers star has no plans to reconnect with his former Celtics teammate
articles.body:
Jaylen Brown isn't interested in having a reunion with Jayson Tatum before the Philadelphia 76ers face the Boston Celtics .

After spending nine seasons together in Boston, the two former championship-winning teammates are preparing to meet as opponents, but Brown has made it clear that he doesn't intend to break the ice before tipoff.

Following Philadelphia's 127-121 victory over the Chicago Bulls on Sunday, Brown faced questions about his relationship with Tatum and whether they had spoken since his departure from Boston.

His initial response was straightforward: “Nope.” When asked whether he intended to approach Tatum before Tuesday's matchup, Brown offered an equally blunt explanation.

“Nothing to talk about. He’s on his side; I’m on my side. We’re both trying to win. So it’s nothing to talk about,” Brown said.

The Philadelphia forward was also asked about the relationships he had maintained in Boston and whether there were people he was particularly looking forward to seeing. He added: “I love Boston. Boston’s a great city. A lot of people I developed a relationship with, I am just focusing on what’s in front of me right now, and that’s the most important thing.”

His comments suggest that Brown wants to keep his attention on his new surroundings rather than revisit the circumstances that ended his time with the Celtics .

That doesn't necessarily mean every personal connection from his Boston years has disappeared, but his relationship with Tatum remains a particularly sensitive subject.

Trade that turned former teammates into rivals

Brown and Tatum were among the NBA's most successful partnerships during their time together. They helped Boston reach five Eastern Conference finals, appeared in two NBA Finals and ultimately won the 2024 championship against the Dallas Mavericks .

Their partnership lasted nine seasons, but the Celtics eventually decided to move Brown in a blockbuster offseason trade in July 2026. He joined Philadelphia in a deal that sent Paul George to Boston alongside draft compensation.

The separation quickly became a talking point after Tatum discussed the trade on his YouTube channel, explaining that he had been caught off guard by the decision.

Brown responded with a blue baseball cap emoji on Instagram, widely interpreted as suggesting that Tatum was not telling the truth.

Tatum subsequently played down suggestions of a serious feud, expressing frustration that the conversation had become focused on personal drama rather than what the pair achieved together.

Brown later offered a memorable response when asked about the possibility of tension between them: “There’s no beef, but it might be a little lamb chops and some gravy. He should stay ready at all times.”

He also made a pointed reference to Tatum 's public messaging, saying the Celtics star had a great PR team.

More than just personal history at stake

Tuesday's meeting is the first regular-season encounter between the former teammates since Brown 's move. Philadelphia enters the contest after improving to 9-2 with its win over Chicago, while Boston is also among the Eastern Conference's leading teams at 8-2.

Brown contributed 29 points against the Bulls , demonstrating the offensive production Philadelphia hoped to acquire when it completed the trade. He has quickly become an important part of a team with ambitions of challenging for the championship.

Tatum , meanwhile, remains central to Boston's plans. His familiarity with Brown 's game could make the individual matchup particularly interesting, while Brown knows the tendencies of a player he spent almost a decade practicing and competing alongside.

The attention surrounding their first competitive meeting will inevitably extend beyond the scoreboard. However, Brown has already made his position clear: he is not planning a conversation before the game.

Whatever remains unresolved between the two players will have to wait until after the basketball is finished.

articles.title: End of the GOAT debate? 30 unbelievable NBA records that prove LeBron’s dominance
articles.standfirst: From scoring milestones to unprecedented longevity, James' remarkable achievements have strengthened the argument for ranking him above Jordan
articles.summary: From scoring milestones to unprecedented longevity, James' remarkable achievements have strengthened the argument for ranking him above Jordan
articles.body:
The debate over basketball's greatest player has followed LeBron James throughout his career, but the Philadelphia 76ers superstar is building a statistical legacy that becomes increasingly difficult to challenge with every passing season.

Now in his record-breaking 24th NBA campaign, James has accumulated an extraordinary collection of achievements spanning scoring, playmaking, postseason success and longevity, extending his influence well beyond the achievements of most former superstars.

The four-time NBA champion is already the league's all-time leading scorer, while also holding records for career field goals, minutes played, games played and All-NBA selections.

His accomplishments have renewed comparisons with Michael Jordan , whose six championships and perfect NBA Finals record remain central arguments for those who consider the Chicago Bulls legend the greatest player ever.

Former Washington Wizards star Gilbert Arenas , however, believes James deserves the distinction because of his sustained excellence across different teams, generations and playing styles.

Speaking on the Get To The Point podcast, Arenas explained how watching James fulfill enormous expectations throughout his career changed his perspective on the debate.

LeBron James' remarkable records

James ' statistical achievements extend far beyond becoming the first player to score 40,000 regular-season points, a milestone he reached after surpassing Kareem Abdul-Jabbar's scoring record in 2023.

He is also the only player to combine at least 40,000 points with 10,000 rebounds and 10,000 assists, demonstrating an unusual balance between scoring and creating opportunities for teammates.

His 21 All-NBA selections, including 13 First Team appearances, represent league records, while his 22 All-Star selections underline his remarkable consistency.

James also leads the NBA in career playoff points, having scored 8,521, comfortably ahead of Jordan 's 5,987.

The forward's achievements include 188 postseason victories, a record 1,297 consecutive regular-season games scoring at least 10 points, and Finals MVP awards with three different franchises.

That versatility particularly impressed Arenas , who recalled how James had originally been described as combining Jordan 's scoring ability with Magic Johnson 's exceptional court vision.

"You said he was Magic Johnson with Michael Jordan ability. What I watched was Magic Johnson with Michael Jordan ability," Arenas said.

All 30 Lebron James NBA records

- NBA all-time leading scorer – Surpassed Kareem Abdul-Jabbar in February 2023 and became the first player to score 40,000 regular-season points.

- Most field goals made in NBA history – Surpassed Abdul-Jabbar's record of 15,837 career field goals and became the first player to make 16,000.

- First player in the 40,000-10,000-10,000 club – The only player to record at least 40,000 points, 10,000 rebounds and 10,000 assists.

- Most career playoff points – Has scored 8,521 postseason points, comfortably ahead of Michael Jordan's 5,987.

- Most All-NBA selections – Has earned 21 All-NBA Team selections during his career.

- Most All-NBA First Team selections – Holds the record with 13 selections.

- Youngest player to make the All-NBA First Team – Earned his first selection following the 2005-06 season at age 21.

- Most NBA All-Star selections – Has been selected for the All-Star Game 22 times.

- Most career NBA All-Star Game points – Has scored 449 points in All-Star appearances.

- Youngest NBA All-Star Game MVP – Won the award in 2006 at 21 years and 51 days old.

- Most regular-season games played – Has surpassed 1,600 career appearances, breaking the previous longevity benchmark.

- Most NBA seasons played – Entered his 24th season in 2026-27, extending the league record.

- Most regular-season minutes played – Has accumulated more than 61,000 minutes during his career.

- Most consecutive games scoring at least 10 points – Extended his remarkable streak to 1,297 regular-season games.

- Most career NBA playoff victories – Has recorded 188 postseason wins.

- Youngest player to reach 5,000 points – Achieved the milestone at 21 years and 22 days old.

- Youngest player to reach 20,000 points – Reached the milestone at 28 years and 17 days old.

- Youngest player to reach 25,000 points – Achieved the milestone at 30 years and 308 days old.

- Youngest NBA Rookie of the Year winner – Won the award in 2004 at 19 years and 123 days old.

- Oldest player to record a triple-double – Registered 28 points, 12 rebounds and 10 assists against the Dallas Mavericks at 41 years old.

- Oldest player to average at least 20 points, five rebounds and five assists – Maintained those averages during his 2025-26 campaign.

- Most regular-season games scoring at least 30 points – Surpassed Michael Jordan's record during the 2024-25 season.

- Most different franchises with NBA Finals MVP awards – Won Finals MVP with the Miami Heat, Cleveland Cavaliers and Los Angeles Lakers.

- First father-son teammates in NBA history – Made history alongside Bronny James with the Lakers in October 2024.

- Most career turnovers in NBA history – Has accumulated more than 5,600 turnovers.

- Most missed field goals in NBA history – Surpassed Kobe Bryant's career total.

- First player to lead a team back from a 3-1 NBA Finals deficit – Helped Cleveland defeat the 73-win Golden State Warriors in 2016.

- Cleveland Cavaliers' all-time leading scorer – Scored 23,119 regular-season points for the franchise.

- Most NBA Player of the Month awards – Has received 41 awards.

- Most NBA Player of the Week awards – Has collected 70 awards during his career.

Why LeBron James deserves the GOAT title

Arenas believes James ' consistency makes his career particularly difficult to criticize, even when compared with Jordan 's championship achievements.

"There's nobody who can say in the 24 years that they went into the season and he failed expectations that season," Arenas continued. "Not one time, not one season you can say was bad. That's GOAT sh*t."

James ' move to Philadelphia has provided another opportunity to extend his legacy, with the 41-year-old pursuing a fifth NBA championship alongside Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey and Jaylen Brown .

Winning another title would make James the first player to capture NBA championships with four different franchises, adding another unprecedented achievement to an already historic career.

Whether those accomplishments are enough to surpass Jordan remains subjective, but James ' extraordinary collection of records has ensured that the argument is far from settled.

articles.title: LeBron James breaks silence after alleged stalker enters his Los Angeles property claiming to be his son
articles.summary: LeBron James addressed a disturbing security incident at his Los Angeles property after a man was arrested on suspicion of felony stalking on Friday, November 6, 2026.
articles.body:
LeBron James addressed a disturbing security incident at his Los Angeles property after a man was arrested on suspicion of felony stalking on Friday, November 6, 2026.

The NBA superstar spoke to reporters on Sunday, November 8, following the Philadelphia 76ers' 127-121 victory over the Chicago Bulls. He emphasized that his family was safe and that they were still gathering information about the incident.

According to the Los Angeles Police Department, officers received a report of a possible burglary suspect at a property in the upscale Brentwood neighborhood at approximately 9:40 p.m. Friday.

Private security personnel had reportedly spotted an unfamiliar man on surveillance cameras and contacted authorities.

Officers arrived and found the suspect on the property. He was taken into custody without incident on suspicion of felony stalking.

Police confirmed that the man was unarmed and did not gain entry into the house itself.

Authorities have not publicly identified the suspect or explained how he accessed the grounds.

According to NBC Los Angeles, the man told responding officers that he was LeBron James' son.

There is no evidence supporting that claim, and investigators have not publicly explained why the suspect made it.

The man's identity and age have not been released.

Authorities also have not confirmed whether he previously attempted to contact James or had been involved in earlier security incidents at the property.

articles.title: Victor Wembanyama’s scary shooting stat makes his dominance even more impressive
articles.standfirst: The giant can dominate opponents through his size, finishing ability, rebounding and shot-blocking
articles.summary: The giant can dominate opponents through his size, finishing ability, rebounding and shot-blocking
articles.body:
Victor Wembanyama is already one of the most difficult players in the NBA to defend, but what makes his recent performances particularly frightening is that he may be doing it without having fully figured out his jump shot.

The San Antonio Spurs superstar delivered a spectacular performance against the Dallas Mavericks on Wednesday, recording 52 points, 24 rebounds and eight blocks. Those numbers would be remarkable for virtually any player, but Wembanyama managed to produce them despite struggling badly with his shooting from the perimeter.

In fact, the French big man was coming off a stretch in which his shooting percentages exposed an unexpected weakness in his offensive game. articles.title: Luka Doncic’s secret behind shocking transformation finally comes out
articles.standfirst: The Lakers superstar is playing at an MVP level, but the biggest change behind Luka Doncic’s rise happened away from the court.
articles.summary: The Lakers superstar is playing at an MVP level, but the biggest change behind Luka Doncic’s rise happened away from the court.
articles.body:
The Los Angeles Lakers have opened the season in spectacular fashion thanks to the absolute dominance of Luka Doncic , who has established himself as the NBA ’s biggest star. No other player in the league is approaching the Slovenian’s scoring pace, currently hovering around 40 points per game .

Doncic’s level has caught the attention of analysts and experts, who agree that something has shifted in his mindset. For the first time in his career, Luka appears fully locked in on one goal: winning the MVP award.

However, behind this dominant version of the Lakers star is a factor beyond the court that helped drive his transformation.

NBA insider Kirk Goldsberry revealed a conversation with a source close to Doncic who explained the difference he has seen in the Slovenian.

“I asked somebody very close to the situation what has gotten into Luka Doncic? I’ve never seen this. And this person said to me, ‘Kirk, he is clear headed,’ and sort of alluding to clouds from last year that were, I think, off the court things.”

According to the report, Doncic is experiencing a period of greater calm and focus after several years filled with major changes. Those included a public divorce and a custody dispute over his son.

In addition, Luka had to adapt to the impact of an unexpected trade from the Dallas Mavericks to the Lakers while navigating a complicated personal chapter. The combination of on-court pressure and off-court issues had affected his performance, but the Slovenian now appears to have found stability and is using it to elevate his game.

Why Luka Doncic is playing differently this season

The mix of personal growth and on-court adjustments has taken Doncic to a level few players have reached.

LeBron James ’s departure triggered a significant roster overhaul for the Lakers, with moves designed to build a team that better fits Luka’s style of play.

Doncic himself has highlighted the new structure, especially after the arrival of center Walker Kessler from the Utah Jazz . The big man gives Luka a defensive presence in the paint and a reliable option to finish plays while the Slovenian dominates opposing defenses with his playmaking.

All of these elements have strengthened Doncic’s chances of finally capturing his first MVP award .

Austin Reaves is the only teammate with a profile close to All-Star level, yet the Slovenian has still produced historic numbers while sharing the offensive load — something that further bolsters his case in the MVP race.

Can Luka Doncic maintain a 40-point average?

Sustaining a 40-point-per-game average over a full season would be a historic feat.

Wilt Chamberlain is the only player in NBA history to clear that barrier for an entire campaign, and he did it twice.

Beyond Chamberlain, only names such as Michael Jordan, Rick Barry, Kobe Bryant, and James Harden have averaged at least 35 points per game across a full season.

While holding Doncic’s current pace looks difficult, an average near 35 points per game could be realistic if he maintains this mindset and continues playing with the same intensity.

The Lakers will also need to manage his minutes carefully, especially in decided games, since keeping their top star healthy will be essential to their aspirations.

Coach JJ Redick has given Doncic full control of the offense, trusting that he is currently one of the most decisive players in the entire NBA.

Regardless of his final numbers, Luka Doncic already stands as one of the leading figures in the MVP race , with Victor Wembanyama among his primary contenders.

articles.title: The resurgence of the player cursed by the NBA: he went broke betting on Russian table tennis and almost took his own life
articles.standfirst: Jontay Porter reveals his process after being banned for life from the NBA for illegal betting
articles.summary: Jontay Porter reveals his process after being banned for life from the NBA for illegal betting
articles.body:
Jontay Porter , the player who was banned for life for trying to defraud the NBA, explains in a lengthy "The New Yorkker" feature that he got deeply involved with FanDuel (a well-known American betting platform) and ended up in debt to the wrong people. The only way out, apparently, was to bet on himself .

The former Grizzlies and Raptors player pleaded guilty in July 2024 in a federal court in Brooklyn to one count of conspiracy to commit wire fraud.

I think you're addicted to the thrill of uncertainty, to that moment when you don't know whether you're going to win or lose

The 2.08 m, 26-year-old power forward was accused of manipulating his performance and colluding with bettors to win bets in two games with the Toronto Raptors during the 2023-24 season.

The scandal erupted after the game the Raptors and the Kings played on March 20, in which Porter withdrew due to illness after playing 2 minutes and 43 seconds with more than discreet numbers: 0 points and 2 rebounds.

For that game, an unusual increase in betting was recorded on Porter's "under," that is, money was being wagered that the player would not reach certain figures. In that game, his "under" lines were set at 7.5 points and 5.5 rebounds.

There was an episode in which... I don't even think my wife knows, but I put the gun to my head while crying and saying: "I can't do this anymore"

An associate of Porter’s had bet $80,000 on the under, which would have won him $1.1 million if the player’s involvement had not been detected.

The NBA reported that Porter "disclosed confidential information to bettors, limited his participation in one or more games, and bet on several NBA games" .

"I'm glad all of that happened with the NBA: the expulsion, the public shame, and the fact that all my dirty laundry came to light. If I hadn't lost my job in the NBA, I would have lost my wife, my family's support, and I might even have lost my life...

The NBA's investigation found it proven that Porter, brother of Denver Nuggets player Michael Porter Jr., withdrew from that game to influence the outcome of those bets.

Jontay Porter's addiction to sports betting that doomed his NBA career

The "The New Yorkker" report explains that Jontay Porter grew up obsessed with money from childhood , and that after suffering a knee injury he moved from trading (buying and selling financial assets) to sportsbooks, registering with FanDuel before turning 21.

That kind of suspense where the final outcome is an unknown—with bloodshot eyes fixed on the screen and your head about to explode—and then suddenly you win and think: "Great, I can keep playing!"

In his first weeks, he wagered more than $30 million on FanDuel, especially on Russian table tennis (he even won a million dollars and lost it in one night ).

Jontay Porter ended up betting more than 50 million on FanDuel over 18 months and losing those millions in cryptocurrency casinos.

As a FanDuel VIP customer, he received bonuses, tickets, and perks from his account manager, the gambling addict Frank Cardenas, whom he considered his only confidant . The company did not verify his income, briefly suspended his account and reactivated it, and gave him credit despite signs that he could not afford those amounts.

With his growing debts, Jontay Porter asked for bets on credit through people linked to alleged mafias .

Jontay Porter's addiction led him to ruin and made him consider taking his own life

In this dire situation, he mortgaged his house for $500,000 and lost everything.

"I think you're addicted to the thrill of uncertainty, to that moment when you don't know whether you're going to win or lose. That kind of suspense in which the final outcome is an unknown—with bloodshot eyes fixed on the screen and your head about to explode—; suddenly you win and think: "Great, I can keep playing!" You feel momentary relief, but right away you start craving that same feeling again," he admits about his addiction.

He lied to his partner about where the money came from. After the wedding in 2022, she discovered the problem; he spent from their accounts and cards and stole from his mother. She became ill from stress and even considered divorce.

His brother Michael paid for a 30-day treatment, but he kept gambling even during his return to the NBA with the Raptors.

To pay off debts, he agreed with some bettors to fake an injury or illness in games so that under bets on his stats would hit. He did it on January 26, 2024 against the Clippers and did it again in March against the Kings.

After the investigation became known and he was expelled from the NBA, divorce was considered and he searched on Google whether he could go to heaven if he took his own life .

He bought a gun and says that, in a moment of desperation, he even put it to his head at a shooting range, crying and saying that he couldn’t take it anymore. What stopped him was thinking about his son, who had not yet been born: he felt that he could not leave the world without meeting him.

"There was an episode in which... I don't even think my wife knows, but I put the gun to my head while crying and saying: "I can't take it anymore"," he recounted.

Gambling addiction has the highest suicide rate of all addictions ; nearly twenty percent of addicted people attempt to take their own lives.

Shortly afterward, he traveled to New York and turned himself in to the authorities.

Jontay Porter: "I'm glad all of that happened with the NBA: the expulsion, the public shame..."

Jontay Porter has not gambled for more than two years, but he says he does not feel cured. He is still in therapy, and his relationship with Michael has been rebuilt.

The former NBA player is still awaiting sentencing and could face up to 20 years in prison for his involvement in the scheme; however, he believes that this whole harsh experience has, deep down, been a blessing in disguise.

"I'm glad all of that happened with the NBA: the expulsion, the public shame, and the fact that all my dirty laundry came to light. If I hadn't lost my job in the NBA, I would have lost my wife, my family's support, and I might even have lost my life... If that (the expulsion) hadn't happened, I wouldn't be here today; and if I were, I would surely still be glued to the phone, looking for where to place my next bet," he said.

Jontay Porter does not blame the bookmakers or his accomplices , he is grateful to the FBI for stepping in and describes himself as the ultimate exponent of a generation of consumerism and greed.

articles.title: Jimmy Butler ‘replaces’ Steve Kerr and gives Warriors the perfect winning strategy: “Pass to Steph”
articles.standfirst: The injured Golden State star surprised everyone with his coaching outfit
articles.summary: The injured Golden State star surprised everyone with his coaching outfit
articles.body:
Jimmy Butler has spent much of the season watching the Golden State Warriors from the sidelines, but the injured superstar found an unusual way to make himself part of the action during Monday's emphatic victory over the New Orleans Pelicans .

Rather than arriving in his customary designer clothing, Butler appeared dressed as a member of Steve Kerr 's coaching staff, complete with a clipboard carrying a particularly straightforward tactical instruction.

"PASS TO STEPH," the message read, leaving little doubt about how Butler believed Golden State should approach its latest assignment.

The unconventional strategy provided an entertaining subplot as the Warriors overwhelmed New Orleans 138-87, securing their eighth consecutive victory after beginning the season with three straight defeats.

Steph Curry scored 25 points in just over 20 minutes, while Brandin Podziemski matched his total and Yaxel Lendeborg contributed 23 as Golden State recorded the NBA's largest winning margin of the season.

Curry also passed DeMar DeRozan for 16th place on the league's all-time scoring list, moving to 26,803 career points and adding another achievement to his remarkable resume.

Butler 's transformation surprised almost everyone inside the Warriors organization, although Kerr revealed that he had discussed the possibility with assistant coach Khalid Robinson before the game.

"I told Khalid 'one of these days we should have Jimmy dress up like us'," Kerr explained afterward.

"He's always got some great outfit on, something fashionable, and we wear our quarter-zips and sweaters."

The coincidence became even more amusing when Butler appeared wearing the coaching staff's attire without apparently knowing that Kerr had suggested the idea.

"I turned to Khalid and said: 'Did you tell him to do that?' He goes: 'no'," Kerr recalled. "It was, I guess, mental telepathy or something. We're on the same page on that. He was enjoying himself."

Butler 's participation extended beyond his outfit and clipboard, with Kerr revealing that the veteran had immersed himself in the responsibilities of his temporary position.

"He said all the right things - how many team fouls we had. He was really acting the part," Kerr added.

Jimmy Butler continues influencing Warriors

Butler remains unavailable after undergoing surgery in February to repair a torn anterior cruciate ligament in his right knee, leaving Golden State without one of its most experienced players.

However, Lendeborg explained that the veteran continues to contribute through his leadership, particularly when advising younger teammates during games.

"For me, especially, he's always just giving me little tips and tricks on the court," Lendeborg said.

His instructions against New Orleans were notably simpler, with the rookie revealing that Butler repeatedly emphasized getting the ball to Golden State's greatest shooter.

"Just give the ball to Steph, that's the most serious thing he said," Lendeborg added.

Golden State's performance demonstrated that its attacking success extends beyond Curry , with the Warriors recording 37 assists and improving their record to 8-3.

The result completed a remarkable turnaround after their difficult opening week, while Butler 's unexpected coaching appearance offered another indication of the positive atmosphere developing around Kerr's team.

articles.summary: Shaq has never been afraid to speak his mind, even to head coaches and front office executives.
articles.body:
By this point, everyone knows Shaquille O'Neal isn't afraid to speak his mind. He does it frequently on his NBA broadcast appearances, but that type of confidence stems from his playing days. He was never shy about telling it how it is.

That, apparently, included a contentious argument with current Miami Heat president Pat Riley . Together with Riley and Dwyane Wade , O'Neal helped the Heat win the NBA Championship in 2006. Riley, who was the head coach at the time, was known to be a strong personality.

Their relationship, unfortunately, deteriorated during the 2007-08 season . The wheels had completely fallen off the wagon after three strong seasons, and it all came to a head during a February 2008 practice, where Riley ordered point guard Jason Williams to leave the practice after he arrived late.

Pat Riley traded away Shaquille O'Neal after he stuck up for Jason Williams at practice

O'Neal stuck up for his teammate, leading to a heated back-and-forth with Riley . Ultimately, that was the final straw for Riley. With the team sitting at a 9-37 record, Riley quickly facilitated a trade to send Shaq to the Phoenix Suns in exchange for Shawn Marion and Marcus Banks .

O'Neal delved deeper into the story during a recent podcast episode, with Wade by his side to help recount it.

Shaq played one and a half seasons with the Suns, then one season with the Cleveland Cavaliers , and one season with the Boston Celtics . By his final season in Miami, it was clear that he had lost some of his dominant skills from yesteryears.

Still, O'Neal completed one of the best careers in NBA history. He may not have seen eye-to-eye with Riley, and even Wade, but together they helped bring a championship to Miami - and no one can take that away.

articles.title: Lakers Austin Reaves’ heated exchange with Pistons fan decoded in lip-reading video
articles.standfirst: Reaves got into a tense back-and-forth with a fan sitting courtside in Detroit.
articles.summary: Reaves got into a tense back-and-forth with a fan sitting courtside in Detroit.
articles.body:
The Los A ngeles Lakers were without Austin Reaves on Monday, but it was for a good reason. Reaves had expended all of his energy on Sunday night, putting together a masterpiece 43-point performance in a road win over the Detroit Pistons . Once again, he stepped up when his team needed it, with Luka Doncic unavailable.

That game also allowed fans to see a different side of Reaves. He usually keeps things close to the vest, and generally opts to not partake in trash talk. But one Pistons fan appeared to really get under his skin, although it clearly didn't affect his on-court performance.

Detroit Pistons fan told Austin Reaves to swing on him

When asked after the win about the tense moment with the Pistons fan, Reaves played it cool: " I don't know what you're talking about ". Fans couldn't let it slide, though, and supposed expert lip readers believe they have deciphered what Reaves and the fan said to each other.

Reaves ended up getting pulled away from the intense conversation with the fan by teammate Matisse Thybulle . Then, later in the game, Reaves hit a dagger to put the game out of reach, pointed at the same fan, and waved him goodbye .

Reaves was clearly annoyed by the trash talk, but he used it to his advantage. It was the exact type of fuel he needed for an epic scoring performance.

articles.title: Philadelphia 76ers vs Boston Celtics: Where to watch the Sixers today and what time the game starts at Wells Fargo
articles.standfirst: Sixers and Celtics clash for the Eastern Conference throne
articles.summary: Sixers and Celtics clash for the Eastern Conference throne
articles.body:
There are games that mean more than just a simple mark in the win column, and the one coming up at the Wells Fargo Center is one of them. The Philadelphia 76ers host the Boston Celtics in a clash that, in addition to the historic spice between the two franchises, has the Atlantic Division lead and a large part of the battle for supremacy in the Eastern Conference on the line.

Two teams started the 2026/27 season on the right foot, and only half a game separates them in the standings. The stage is set for a heavyweight battle.

Philadelphia 76ers vs Boston Celtics: What time and where to watch the game

The game will be played this Tuesday, November 10, 2026, with tip-off officially scheduled for 8:00 p.m. Eastern Time (7:00 p.m. Central Time and 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time), at the Wells Fargo Center in Philadelphia, a venue with a capacity of 20,478 fans.

In the United States, the national broadcast of this matchup will be carried by NBC, as well as on NBC Sports local channels for Philadelphia and Boston; in addition, you can stream it on Peacock and Fubo. For international audiences, the NBA maintains its usual offering through NBA League Pass.

How do the Sixers and Celtics come into today's game? Standings and latest results

The image of the standings leaves no room for doubt about the magnitude of this matchup. Philadelphia leads the Atlantic Division with a record of 9 wins and 2 losses (.818), a mark that also leaves it tied at the very top of the entire league in winning percentage.

Boston is right on its heels: 8 wins and 2 losses (.800), just half a game back, in second place in the division.

The stat that should concern the home fans is the defensive one. The 76ers have allowed 1,187 points in their eleven games, a high figure that contrasts with Boston's solidity. The Celtics boast the best point differential in the East, the result of a defense that has conceded just 1,043 points in ten games.

In short: Philadelphia wins with offense and determination; Boston does it by locking things down. That difference in styles is exactly what makes the matchup appealing.

Philadelphia 76ers vs Boston Celtics Lineups: plenty of stars on the court

Few early-season games bring together so much recognizable talent on the court. In Philadelphia’s ranks appears a roster with big-name talent: Joel Embiid commanding the paint, Tyrese Maxey and Anfernee Simons providing dynamite on the perimeter, veteran LeBron James adding experience and stature, and Jaylen Brown reinforcing the wing.

It is a roster built to score in bursts, and the 1,221 points scored — the second-best offense in the East — confirm it.

On the other side, Boston leans on its longtime backbone. Jayson Tatum leads the project as the franchise standard-bearer, with Derrick White and Payton Pritchard handling the ball and punishing from beyond the arc.

The arrival of a shooter and defender of Paul George's caliber adds another layer of danger on the wing, while Mitchell Robinson and the Portuguese Neemias Queta bring muscle and rim protection in the paint.

Tactical chess is played in the paint: Embiid against the defensive front of Robinson and Queta will be one of the silent keys to the game. And on the perimeter, if Maxey and Simons find their rhythm from three, Boston’s defense will have to stretch like rarely before this season.

What is at stake in the Eastern Conference standings

This game is, in effect, an early tiebreaker for the top spot in the Atlantic. A Philadelphia victory would extend its lead over Boston and solidify its position among the teams with the best record in the entire NBA, alongside the Los Angeles Lakers at the top of the league standings.

A Celtics win, on the other hand, would allow them to seize the divisional lead and move ahead of their rival in the overall standings, where they are currently in third place, half a game behind.

Beyond the mathematics of November, these early-season matchups establish hierarchies. In a conference where Detroit, Atlanta, and the Knicks also want to force their way into the conversation, making it clear who is in charge in the Atlantic has a psychological value that transcends the calendar.

Prediction for the Philadelphia 76ers vs Boston Celtics: Who will win today's game?

It is an extremely even matchup, the kind that is usually decided in the final minutes. The home-court advantage and offensive depth tilt the balance slightly toward Philadelphia, but Boston’s defensive solidity —the best in the East by point differential— is a strong argument for stealing a road win.

If the game turns into a scoring race, the 76ers have the arsenal to win it at home; if Boston manages to slow the pace and defend as it has throughout the campaign, the result could go the green side's way by a narrow margin. We’re betting on a nail-biting finish with a slight edge for the home team.

articles.title: Jemele Hill defends Ayesha Curry after she kisses another man and compares her to Hailee Steinfeld: “Weird sort of misogyny”
articles.standfirst: The sports journalist has challenged the criticism aimed at Stephen Curry’s wife, arguing that her acting career should not be defined by her marriage
articles.summary: The sports journalist has challenged the criticism aimed at Stephen Curry’s wife, arguing that her acting career should not be defined by her marriage
articles.body:
A yesha Curry ’s latest acting role has sparked an unexpected debate about marriage, celebrity and the freedom to pursue a career outside the public image of a famous spouse.

But journalist Jemele Hill believes the backlash over one scene in Curry’s new romantic comedy says more about attitudes toward women than it does about the film.

Curry stars opposite Matthew Daddario in Second Chance Holiday, which arrived on The Roku Channel on November 5. The movie follows Chelsey, a dating expert who returns home after a series of holiday breakups and reconnects with her high school sweetheart.

A kiss between the two characters quickly became a talking point online, with former NFL running back LeSean McCoy among those questioning Curry’s decision to take part in the scene.

The reaction was particularly striking because Curry’s husband, Golden State Warriors star Stephen Curry , had publicly celebrated her new project.

Responding to the trailer in late October, he wrote: “My Leading Lady,” before adding, “I get to see the work behind the scenes and now the world gets to see you shine and this is just the beginning…”

McCoy , however, took a different view during an episode of the Speakeasy podcast. Referring to Stephen’s standing as one of basketball’s greatest players, he questioned why Ayesha would film a romantic scene with another actor.

“What we doin'? Is this real?” McCoy said. “Bro, this is crazy. You got one of the greatest players of all time as your husband, and every time—I don't know if it's me, or […] I seen a while ago where she keeps saying how she wants more attention. And how girls throw themselves at him, and she just still wants to feel like she's wanted.”

McCoy was referring to Curry’s 2019 appearance on Red Table Talk, where she spoke about feeling overlooked while her husband received attention from other women.

At the time, she explained that the experience had affected her confidence and made her question whether something was wrong with her.

“Something that really bothers me and has given me a sense of a little bit of an insecurity is the fact that, yeah, there are all these women throwing themselves,” Ayesha Curry said.

“But me, the past ten years, I don't have any of that. I have zero, this sounds weird, male attention. And so I begin to internalize it. And I'm like, is something wrong with me?”

Hill points to a double standard involving Hailee Steinfeld

McCoy continued to criticize the scene, despite acknowledging that Curry had explained it was not real.

He said: “Yo, we're getting carried away now, though. Now you're in a scene kissing a dude? Ain't look like Steph to me. Bro, I ain't married. And I don't want to speak for people that's not married. But I gotta say something: This is crazy. Why you kissing this man like that? Now, she did say it's not real. So if it's not real, then I respect it.”

Curry herself offered a brief response to the online reaction, writing: “It's not even real 🤣 you guys are annoying.”

Hill stepped in on November 7, arguing that the criticism ignored Curry’s ambitions and the fact that acting was something she had pursued long before marrying Stephen.

She also brought Buffalo Bills quarterback Josh Allen’ s wife, actress Hailee Steinfeld, into the discussion.

Hill wrote: “1) Ayesha Curry wanted to be an actress prior to being married to Steph. She was in commercials as a kid, did an episode of Hannah Montana and appeared in other things as a child actress.

“2) Hailee Stenfield is Josh Allen 's wife. She has a pretty graphic sex scene with Michael B. Jordan in Sinners and I heard not one peep or any pearl clutching (not that there should have been).

“I find all the conversations about Ayesha Curry to be rooted in a weird sort of misogyny where people get mad at her because she won't just sit down, shut up and have her entire existence wrapped up in her husband. How dare this woman actually try to find some sort of purpose that's unrelated to her being a wife and mother?

Steinfeld’s performance in Sinners provides Hill’s comparison: the actress appeared in the film alongside Michael B. Jordan, including an intimate scene, without attracting the same level of public discussion that Hill believes Curry has faced.

The wider issue, in Hill’s view, is the expectation that a woman married to a celebrated athlete should keep her ambitions within the boundaries of that relationship.

Curry’s career has included television appearances, cooking projects, business ventures and acting, while she and Stephen have built a family together.

For now, the four-time NBA champion has made his support for his wife’s latest project clear. And with Second Chance Holiday marking her first leading role in a feature film, the conversation has become about considerably more than a scripted kiss.

articles.title: Stephen Curry’s latest transformation could make the Warriors championship contenders again
articles.standfirst: Golden State's offensive transformation becomes even more impressive when considering how their season began
articles.summary: Golden State's offensive transformation becomes even more impressive when considering how their season began
articles.body:
Stephen Curry is approaching his 38th birthday, but his shooting touch remains as dangerous as ever. The Golden State Warriors superstar is connecting on a scorching 45.7% of his attempts from beyond the arc, demonstrating that age has done little to diminish his ability to change games with his shooting. And there might be a new reason behind his remarkable efficiency: Golden State has reinvented the way it builds its offense around him.

For years, the Warriors revolutionized basketball with their small-ball lineups, spacing and relentless ball movement. During their championship dynasty in the mid-2010s, Curry and Draymond Green became the foundation of an offensive system that overwhelmed opponents through their devastating two-man game.

That partnership remains important, but Golden State is introducing a different approach this season. Rather than relying so heavily on Curry and Green to generate offense through their familiar pick-and-roll combinations, the Warriors are surrounding their superstar with shooters, floor-spacers and connectors.

The result is a five-out offensive system that gives Curry more room to operate, more opportunities to attack defensive mismatches and greater freedom to create shots for himself and his teammates.

A new offensive approach is bringing out the best in Curry

The Warriors have traditionally depended on Curry’s ability to create advantages through off-ball movement, screens and his partnership with Green. However, the current offensive adjustments are allowing the four-time NBA champion to operate in a more open environment.

With all five players capable of occupying perimeter positions and contributing to the offense, opposing defenses face a difficult decision: commit additional defenders to Curry or risk leaving another shooter open. That additional spacing is particularly valuable for a player who remains one of the greatest perimeter threats in basketball history.

Curry’s 45.7% shooting from three-point range illustrates how effective the approach has been. At an age when most players are experiencing a decline in athleticism and offensive production, he continues to punish defenses with extraordinary efficiency. His recent performances also suggest that his individual brilliance is translating into team success.

In the Warriors ’ 126-119 overtime victory against the Orlando Magic, Curry erupted for 41 points, recording his second 40-point performance of the season. The performance tied Oscar Robertson for eighth place on the NBA’s all-time list for 40-point games.

He also extended another remarkable shooting streak, making at least five three-pointers in five consecutive games. It was the eighth time in his career that he had produced such a streak within a single season, twice as many as any other player in NBA history.

From an 0-3 start to a historic winning streak

The Warriors’ offensive transformation becomes even more impressive when considering how their season began. Golden State lost its first three games, raising questions about the team’s ceiling after entering the campaign without Jimmy Butler and Moses Moody . The situation became even more complicated when Kristaps Porziņģis announced that he was stepping away from basketball.

Rather than panic, the Warriors remained committed to their approach and responded with eight consecutive victories, becoming the first team in NBA history to follow a three-game losing streak to open a season with an eight-game winning streak.

The turnaround has been particularly impressive because Golden State hasn’t simply been winning close games. Four victories during the streak came after double-digit comebacks, marking only the second time in franchise history the team has accomplished that feat.

The supporting cast is making the difference

Curry’s individual production naturally attracts most of the attention, but Golden State’s improved offensive structure is also benefiting from contributions throughout the roster. During the winning streak, the Warriors have been the NBA’s best three-point shooting team, connecting on 40.3% of their attempts. They have also recorded a 70% assist rate, the second-highest mark in the league, demonstrating how effectively the team is moving the basketball.

Their bench has been another major advantage, accumulating 492 points during the streak to rank among the NBA’s top three scoring units . Those numbers help explain why the new five-out approach is working. Golden State isn’t simply asking Curry to take more difficult shots or carry an overwhelming offensive burden. Instead, the Warriors are creating an environment in which multiple players can contribute to the same possession.

Green’s passing and decision-making remain valuable, but the presence of additional shooters and playmakers gives Curry more options. Defenses can no longer focus exclusively on stopping the familiar Curry-Green combination without exposing other areas of the floor. The improved spacing also creates opportunities for Steph to attack closeouts, exploit switches and find open teammates when opposing defenses send extra help.

articles.title: Billion-dollar play: LeBron James and Kevin Durant launch a new league that threatens Nike's basketball monopoly
articles.standfirst: The NBA superstars are backing the Futures Basketball League, a new competition offering elite high school prospects NIL money, professional development and an alternative to the established grassroots basketball system
articles.summary: The NBA superstars are backing the Futures Basketball League, a new competition offering elite high school prospects NIL money, professional development and an alternative to the established grassroots basketball system
articles.body:
LeBron James and Kevin Durant are preparing to make another major impact on basketball, this time by investing in the next generation rather than competing against each other on an NBA court.

The two superstars are among the founding partners behind the Futures Basketball League (FBL), a new high school competition that could challenge the influence of Nike's Elite Youth Basketball League (EYBL).

Announced on November 10, the project is scheduled to begin in April 2027. It will bring together 120 of the country's leading boys' basketball prospects from the high school classes of 2028 through 2031, dividing them into 12 regional teams for a season running through August.

James' LRMR Ventures and Durant's Boardroom Sports Holdings are among the investors. Other prominent names involved include former NBA MVP Derrick Ros e, Orlando Magic star Paolo Banchero , entrepreneur Gary Vaynerchuk and several sports-business investors.

The idea is to create a more organized pathway for young players, combining elite competition with coaching, education, strength and conditioning, recovery services and individual development plans.

It is also a business opportunity for athletes who have increasingly become valuable brands before even reaching college basketball.

Eligible players will be able to receive name, image and likeness (NIL) compensation in cash, league equity or a combination of the two, subject to administrative approvals. They will also remain free to pursue sponsorship agreements with outside companies, including footwear brands.

Can LeBron and Durant challenge Nike's grassroots dominance?

Nike's EYBL has long been one of the most influential platforms in American youth basketball.

Established in 2010, the circuit has helped showcase elite prospects to college recruiters and provided a pathway toward the highest levels of the sport. Competing against that established structure will be a significant challenge for FBL.

The new league's spring and summer calendar will overlap with parts of the traditional grassroots season, potentially creating competition for players, coaches and attention.

However, FBL says its schedule will accommodate high school basketball, NCAA recruiting periods, USA Basketball commitments and the NBPA Top 100 Camp.

Maverick Carter , James' longtime business partner and an FBL co-founder, explained why he believes the existing system needs an alternative.

“As someone who grew up playing grassroots and then college ball, and watched another kid from Akron completely change the landscape of high school basketball, I’ve seen how the game has evolved over the years both for the athletes and the ecosystem surrounding them,” Carter said.

“With interest in these athletes at an all-time high, I believe Futures is the premier league with the right infrastructure to really help grow and develop players while setting them up for long-term success.”

MADE Hoops will handle league operations, while HMBL Development will oversee training and individualized player-development programs.

FBL has also pledged $1 million to the MADE For All Foundation, which supports scholarships and community initiatives for young basketball players.

Rose , who is also a founding team owner, highlighted the importance of providing young athletes with guidance beyond the court: “I came up through the grassroots circuit in Chicago, and I saw how much talent could benefit from real structure and support. I was lucky, my brothers built a wall around me and made sure the right people were in my corner. Most young players don’t have that. Futures gives them that kind of protection and support, off the court as much as on it.”

The league has already begun signing prospects to NIL agreements, with its first player announcements expected in the coming weeks.

Despite the headline-grabbing backing, FBL has not been valued at a billion dollars, and Nike's position is not about to disappear overnight.

Its real challenge will be persuading elite players and their families that its financial incentives, development resources and national exposure offer something better than the established circuits.

For James and Durant, however, the opportunity is clear: influence the future of basketball while building a new business around the sport they have dominated for years. The first major test arrives when the league tips off in 2027.

articles.title: What's going on with Luka? Doncic's inner circle reveals the shocking off-field reason behind his incredible form
articles.standfirst: Luka Doncic is enjoying a sensational start to the season in Los Angeles
articles.summary: Luka Doncic is enjoying a sensational start to the season in Los Angeles
articles.body:
The Los Angeles Lakers have found themselves riding a six-game winning streak, with Luka Doncic at the center of their impressive start to the 2026-27 campaign.

The Slovenian guard has been piling up points at an extraordinary rate, but one NBA analyst believes there is a less obvious explanation for his transformation.

Kirk Goldsberry recently shared an intriguing conversation with someone close to Doncic . Rather than pointing to a tactical adjustment or a change in the Lakers ' offensive system, the person offered a simple description of the player's current state of mind.

“I asked somebody very close to the situation this weekend. I was like, what has gotten into Luka Doncic ? I’ve never seen this. And this person said to me, ‘Kirk, he is clear headed,’” Goldsberry said.

The comment has fueled speculation about whether developments away from basketball have helped Doncic find a better sense of balance.

Goldsberry did not reveal the identity of his source or provide details about what may have changed. Consequently, it would be premature to attribute the player's form to any particular personal matter.

What the observation does highlight is the importance of mental clarity for a player carrying the responsibility Doncic has in Los Angeles.

He is expected to dictate the offense, create opportunities for teammates and deliver when the Lakers need a basket. Being able to approach those demands with greater focus could be a significant advantage.

The summer that helped Doncic rediscover his energy

There is also a physical explanation worth considering. Doncic has openly discussed how much he benefited from having an offseason to recover properly, something he said had been difficult to achieve during previous years of his career.

“I had some good stretches in my career. But obviously this could be one of the highest ones. But there’s still some work to do,” Doncic said after the Lakers ' November 4 victory over Sacramento.

He then offered a more revealing account of how the summer had affected him: “I had the whole summer to recover. A lot of stuff that I couldn’t do in the last maybe eight years. So that’s where the energy is coming from.”

That additional recovery time may be helping him sustain the demanding style of basketball that has made him one of the NBA's most difficult players to defend.

Doncic combines scoring with exceptional passing ability, meaning opponents cannot simply focus on limiting his shots without risking opportunities for his teammates.

The results during the first week of November were remarkable. Doncic scored 42 points against Miami on November 2, followed by 40 against Sacramento on November 4 and a season-high 53 against Portland on November 6. The three victories also secured him the Western Conference Player of the Week award.

According to the NBA's official announcement, he averaged 45.0 points, 7.0 rebounds and 8.3 assists across those games.

Goldsberry also recalled what Doncic achieved when he was able to complete a season in good physical condition, pointing to the Mavericks' run to the 2024 NBA Finals.

“But I think Luka is dialed in, in a way, and healthy in a way. Like, remember, this is the dude who won the Western Conference the last time he finished the season healthy,” Goldsberry said.

The Lakers have already seen how important his availability is. After missing the November 8 game against Detroit because of lower-back tightness, Doncic returned against Atlanta on November 9 with 32 points, eight rebounds and 10 assists. Los Angeles won 124-114, extending its winning streak to six games and improving its record to 10-2.

Goldsberry believes the current level could be sustainable, although he stopped short of making any guarantees.

“So he deserves a lot of respect. Maybe this thing is sustainable,” he said.

The season is still in its early stages, and maintaining such extraordinary production will require continued health and consistency. Nevertheless, Doncic appears to have found a combination that is working: renewed energy, improved physical preparation and a mindset that those close to him describe as clearer.

For the Lakers, that combination could be more valuable than any individual scoring record. If Doncic can maintain it throughout the campaign, the rest of the Western Conference will have a serious problem.
