articles.title: Jaylen Brown’s pregame snub of Jayson Tatum fuels rivalry talk after nine years together
articles.standfirst: Brown kept spinning the ball as Tatum tried to greet him before tipoff. The Celtics star then turned to LeBron James, who welcomed him with a hug
articles.summary: Brown kept spinning the ball as Tatum tried to greet him before tipoff. The Celtics star then turned to LeBron James, who welcomed him with a hug
articles.body:
J aylen Brown and Jayson Tatum’s first game as opponents delivered the reunion NBA fans had been waiting for but their brief pregame exchange was strikingly cold. As the starters gathered near midcourt, Tatum walked over and appeared to offer Brown a quick dap or handshake.

Brown kept spinning the ball and did not return the greeting. He carried on as if nothing had happened, while Tatum gave him a light tap on the arm or chest before moving away. The moment looked like a clear snub, though the clip alone cannot tell us what Brown intended.

Tatum then turned to LeBron James, who greeted him warmly and pulled him into a hug. The contrast made the moment with Brown stand out even more. Tatum’s expression seemed to register the awkwardness, but it is impossible to know what he was thinking from a brief video.

The lack of a greeting after the final buzzer fueled talk of a possible rivalry even more. Jaylen Brown crossed the court to greet several of his former Celtics teammates while Tatum was doing an NBC interview. They still didn’t cross paths, though the interview offered a reasonable explanation. If either of them had wanted to, they could have made it happen.

This second seemingly unplanned missed connection is making people wonder whether the rumors might be true , despite the time they spent sharing a locker room.

Brown and Tatum spent nine seasons together in Boston , reaching five Eastern Conference finals and two NBA Finals before winning the 2024 championship. Brown was named Finals MVP, while Tatum became the franchise’s central star.

They often spoke about pushing each other to improve, but speculation about tension between the two followed them throughout their time as teammates.

Their partnership ended when Boston traded Brown to the 76ers in July. Tatum said he was surprised by the deal and tried to call and text Brown afterward. Brown later responded to a video of Tatum discussing the trade with a blue cap emoji, a slang reference to “cap,” or a lie. Tatum has denied having any animosity, while Brown has said there is “nothing to talk about” between them.

Paul George leads Boston past Philadelphia

The Celtics’ 123-101 win gave the reunion a decisive on-court backdrop. Paul George led Boston with 36 points, Tatum added 21, and Payton Pritchard scored 18. Tatum also forced a turnover from Brown early in the game, then scored on a dunk and a layup on consecutive possessions.

Tyrese Maxey led Philadelphia with 24 points, followed by Anfernee Simons with 17 and Joel Embiid with 16. Brown finished with 13 points. Boston pulled away in the fourth quarter, outscoring the 76ers 32-19 and improving to 9-2, while Philadelphia fell to 9-3.

After nine seasons, a championship and years of public respect, the former teammates’ first meeting as opponents ended with no warm reunion.

The unanswered greeting and the silence after the game gave the rivalry talk fresh fuel, even if neither moment can tell the full story of what happened between them.

articles.title: Shaquille O’Neal switches Stephen Curry’s position, much to Kevin Durant’s amazement: “Steph ain’t no point guard”
articles.standfirst: Shaq sparked an unexpected debate during a discussion about the NBA's greatest players
articles.summary: Shaq sparked an unexpected debate during a discussion about the NBA's greatest players
articles.body:
S teph Curry 's status as one of the greatest point guards in basketball history has rarely been questioned, but Shaquille O’Neal has offered a different perspective that caught Kevin Durant 's attention as the four-time NBA champion sparked an entertaining debate during an appearance. The two legendary basketballers discussed their all-time starting lineups and the qualities needed to build a championship-winning team and the conversation took an interesting turn when Curry 's name entered the discussion.

Assembled by co-host Ben Persky on the Rushmore Podcast, who selected Curry alongside Kawhi Leonard , Larry Bird , Tim Duncan and Wilt Chamberlain and O’Neal was quick to question the construction of the team, particularly the decision to use Curry as its floor general. And O’Neal challenged the idea that the Golden State Warriors superstar should automatically be considered a point guard, coming in stark contrast to Curry 's reputation as one of basketball's most influential players. "Steph ain't no point guard. Come on, dawg,” Shaq said to the show, pushing back on the inclusion of the superstar before later adding: "Four ain't big man, four got their own category. it's called power forward." His shooting ability, movement without the ball and impact on offensive spacing have transformed how teams approach the game, but O’Neal believes the traditional positional label does not necessarily reflect his responsibilities on the court as the disagreement emerged as the group examined a hypothetical best starting five. The former Los Angeles Lakers center has always viewed basketball through the lens of physical matchups and traditional positional responsibilities, making the Warriors star's role an interesting talking point. Curry is officially listed as a point guard, but his game has never depended exclusively on controlling possession. His ability to create opportunities through constant movement, attract multiple defenders and score from virtually anywhere makes him a different proposition from conventional playmakers. That distinction was central to the discussion, with Shaq 's comments challenging the way modern basketball evaluates positions.

Kevin Durant joins the debate as Shaq questions Curry's defensive limitations

Durant also had reservations about Persky 's proposed lineup, although his biggest concern was not necessarily Curry 's offensive responsibilities as the Houston Rockets ace immediately highlighted the defensive problems that could emerge if he were matched against larger opponents. Durant 's argument centered on the physical mismatches his lineup could create, particularly with LeBron James potentially attacking Curry defensively as he believed his collection of bigger players would have a significant advantage in those situations. "Too small. Too small for me. Steph guarding LeBron? No way," Durant said, laughing during the conversation as his reaction illustrated the difference between selecting players based on individual accomplishments and constructing a team capable of competing against other all-time great combinations. Interestingly, Shaq 's wider appreciation of Curry should not be mistaken for a lack of respect as O’Neal has repeatedly praised the Warriors superstar, previously describing his ability to dominate games as something he had rarely witnessed from a smaller guard. He has also backed Curry in discussions about the greatest point guards in NBA history. During an earlier appearance on another podcast, Shaq even placed him ahead of Magic Johnson , arguing that basketball's evolution should influence how the position is judged.

articles.title: "I've never seen an NBA champion whose three stars were white, and it's not going to happen this year"
articles.standfirst: Controversial analyst Stephen A. Smith makes a prediction about the Lakers based on the race of their three main stars
articles.summary: Controversial analyst Stephen A. Smith makes a prediction about the Lakers based on the race of their three main stars
articles.body:
Like in the old days, the NBA slate has left the Celtics atop the Eastern Conference and the Lakers in charge of the West . The Los Angeles team, with a 10-2 record, are the leaders of the competition. Good vibes with a Luka Doncic from another planet (averaging 39.3 points, 7.8 rebounds, 7.9 assists and 2.0 steals), but perhaps too early to know what the team’s true aspirations are.

However, there are those who are already certain they will not be contenders for the title. And in reaching that conclusion, he does not point to their play or talent... but to race . The controversial analyst Stephen A. Smith claims: "I have never seen an NBA team with three white players as its main stars win a championship . It has never happened, and I assure you I do not believe it is going to happen this year."

The aforementioned Doncic, Austin Reaves, and newly signed Walker Kessler are the Lakers' stars, and being Caucasian seems to be a drawback in Smith's opinion. "I know it's controversial, but I don't think they'll get past the second round. I would be very surprised if they did" , says the analyst, who has the Thunder , the Spurs , and even the Nuggets ahead of them, and believes they would be evenly matched with the Rockets and the Timberwolves once Anthony Edwards recovers.

Eliminated in the second round despite having Doncic

Smith's speech does not deny the obvious, the great moment of Doncic: "He is unstoppable. He is leaving everyone open-mouthed. He is going to be an MVP candidate. There is no doubt that he is special” . He believes that "the Lakers are a playoff team," but once in the title series he does not give them many chances: "They will reach the second round, suffer a humiliating defeat and go home" .

The analyst does believe that in the future the Lakers can aspire to very great heights. "The new front office is led by Kushner and Bob Iger . Bob Iger is, in my opinion, the Michael Jordan of sports. He is the best executive I have ever known, a mentor and a friend. articles.summary: After three weeks of play, the Celtics and the 76ers are the top teams in the Eastern Conference
articles.body:
One of the most anticipated matchups of the 2026-27 NBA season unfolded on Tuesday night, as the Boston Celtics delivered a statement 123-101 victory over the Philadelphia 76ers . The marquee clash marked the first direct head-to-head battle between former championship teammates Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown following the summer’s blockbuster trade that sent Paul George to Boston.

Stepping onto his former home floor, George easily outplayed Brown in their initial meeting, delivering his finest performance in a Celtics uniform to reintroduce himself to the Philadelphia crowd. George put on a masterclass performance, exploding for a game-high 36 points on an efficient 14-of-22 shooting from the field, including six 3-pointers and five rebounds.

The veteran star completely put the game out of reach in the final period, single-handedly scoring 14 consecutive Boston points in the fourth quarter . Franchise cornerstone Jayson Tatum added 21 points to seal the blowout win.

On the opposing side, Brown, who visibly avoided a pre-game greeting with Tatum, struggled mightily, recording just 13 points while finishing with a game-worst -27 box plus-minus . Reflecting on the tough night, Brown admitted after the loss, “I was looking forward to this. I was looking forward to playing well, but I guess (s***) happens.”

Paul George Confronts Hostile Philadelphia Crowd with Gesture

Unsurprisingly, George was greeted with heavy boos from the Philadelphia faithful throughout the night. Following the game, George noted that the arena carried a tense energy that mimicked the intensity of a high-stakes postseason environment.

“This building can be very electric as well,” George remarked. However, one specific sideline interaction extended beyond typical fan banter.

During a play stoppage, the ball rolled toward a fan seated along the baseline. George recalled that the fan stared directly at him before intentionally dropping the ball on the hardwood rather than handing it over.

“There was a fan being an a--,” George explained. “The ball rolled to him. He looked me dead in my eyes, dropped the ball on the ground as if I’m a dog to go fetch or go get it, instead of passing the ball to me like a normal fan would do. Then I rolled him a middle finger in return.”

That date marks Jaylen Brown’s return to TD Garden for the first time as a visiting player, where Celtics fans will gather to greet their former Finals MVP in an opposing jersey.

George's return was met with boos from Philadelphia fans, adding tension to the matchup. Despite the hostile reception and the viral incident, he described the arena's atmosphere as exciting and acknowledged his relationships with former teammates. No NBA disciplinary action related to the gesture had been confirmed at the time of reporting.

articles.title: LA Lakers vs Milwaukee Bucks: Where to watch the game and what time the opening tip will be at Fiserv Forum
articles.standfirst: League-leading Lakers visit a struggling Bucks team; Luka and company look to remain unstoppable at Fiserv Forum
articles.summary: League-leading Lakers visit a struggling Bucks team; Luka and company look to remain unstoppable at Fiserv Forum
articles.body:
The NBA schedule gives us a clash of opposite realities. The Los Angeles Lakers , the best team in the league by record, arrive in Milwaukee to face the Milwaukee Bucks , who are going through one of the worst starts in the entire competition.

On paper it looks like a blowout; on the hardwood, the pride of a wounded team in its own home always deserves attention.

LA Lakers vs Milwaukee Bucks: Time and where to watch the game

The matchup between Milwaukee and Los Angeles will be played this Wednesday, November 12, 2026, at Milwaukee's Fiserv Forum , a venue with a capacity of 17,500 fans. The game's start time will be as follows for each time zone:

The local broadcast will be available on the Bucks App in the Milwaukee market, while Los Angeles fans will be able to follow it through Spectrum Sports Net and Spectrum Sports Net +. Nationally, the NBA will broadcast the game through Amazon Prime Video and NBA League Pass.

The Lakers vs. Bucks landscape: heaven and hell on the same court

The numbers tell the story on their own. The Lakers rule the Western Conference with a record of 10 wins and 2 losses, the best mark in the entire NBA , even surpassing the Philadelphia 76ers and the San Antonio Spurs in the overall standings. With 1,465 points scored and a +92 point differential, Los Angeles' offense is a steamroller.

On the other side, the Bucks are living a nightmare. With only 1 win and 9 losses, they sit at the bottom of the Central Division and in the third-worst spot among the league's 30 teams , ahead of only the Sacramento Kings and the Utah Jazz. Their -132 differential reveals a deep-rooted defensive problem: they have allowed 1,216 points in just ten games.

The Lakers' streak is devastating. They have won nine of their last ten games, including statement victories such as the 138-117 over the Miami Heat and gritty wins over direct rivals: 121-116 on the road against the Detroit Pistons and, on that same November 10, a 124-114 victory on the Atlanta Hawks' home court.

Their only recent blemish was a 136-129 loss to the Portland Trail Blazers. They come in hot and used to winning away from Crypto.com Arena.

Milwaukee, meanwhile, is carrying a deep wound: it comes in with eight losses in its last nine games. The most painful was a 97-117 defeat on its own court against the Boston Celtics on November 9, just days after also falling to those same Celtics (109-102) on the road.

The only respite was a 110-102 win over the Indiana Pacers in late October. Fiserv Forum, which should be a fortress, has turned into the scene of blowouts: 136 points allowed against the Cleveland Cavaliers, 132 against the Houston Rockets.

The players to watch in the Los Angeles and Milwaukee lineups

The main attraction is, without a doubt, Luka Dončić. The 27-year-old Slovenian leads the Los Angeles project and is the compass of a team that keeps racking up wins. Alongside him, Austin Reaves provides steady production from the perimeter, and Collin Sexton adds scoring energy whether coming off the bench or joining the starting five.

In the paint, the Lakers boast rotation with Walker Kessler, Deandre… —or rather, with pieces like Kevon Looney and Jarred Vanderbilt who give them muscle and rebounding.

Milwaukee does not lack talent, though it does lack results. Tyler Herro leads the backcourt, and Myles Turner must anchor a leaky defense. Kyle Kuzma and the young Jaime Jaquez Jr. round out a group that urgently needs to find its identity.

The challenge for the Bucks is to slow down the breakneck pace at which Los Angeles plays and to stop giving away points in transition.

What's at stake in the NBA standings

For the Lakers, every victory is worth gold in a brutally tight Western Conference: the San Antonio Spurs, Oklahoma City Thunder, Golden State Warriors, Houston Rockets, and Minnesota Timberwolves are lurking just a game and a half behind. Staying on top requires not relaxing against any opponent, no matter how low they may be.

Milwaukee, meanwhile, is fighting a different battle: avoiding sinking completely to the bottom of the East, where the Chicago Bulls are its immediate neighbor. Every loss brings them closer to the absolute bottom of the league and further from any aspirations of play-in spots.

What is the prediction for the LA Lakers vs Milwaukee Bucks?

The logic is overwhelming: the Lakers are the best team in the NBA by record and arrive in superb form, while the Bucks are one of the hardest-hit teams in the league.

We expect an away win, probably a comfortable one, if Milwaukee fails to turn the support of the Fiserv Forum into defensive intensity from the first quarter. The Bucks' only path is to turn the game into a physical, slow-paced battle and trust that the talent of Herro and Turner keeps them within striking distance until the final period.

On a neutral court or in any scenario, the balance clearly tilts toward Los Angeles.

articles.title: LeBron James faces harsh criticism after controversial reaction to Paul George contact
articles.standfirst: The Lakers star became the target of NBA fans after staying on the floor following a minor hit during Philadelphia’s loss to Boston
articles.summary: The Lakers star became the target of NBA fans after staying on the floor following a minor hit during Philadelphia’s loss to Boston
articles.body:
L eBron James’ attitude on the court has often been a reflection of how things are going for his team. When the result is favorable, the 41-year-old can be seen joking with fans and doing his part to keep the atmosphere positive. However, his reaction during the Philadelphia 76ers' 123-101 defeat to the Boston Celtics sparked a very different conversation , with NBA fans questioning his behavior.

James found himself at the center of attention after an incident involving Paul George, who appeared to swipe at his face during the game . Rather than immediately getting back up, L eBron remained on the floor waiting for the referees to react to what he considered possible contac t. The moment quickly went viral, but not because of a standout play or a positive contribution to the game.

LeBron's reaction becomes a talking point

The footage triggered criticism across social media, with several fans accusing the veteran of exaggerating the contact in an attempt to draw a foul. Some argued that the hit was barely noticeable, making his decision to stay down look unnecessary , particularly with Philadelphia already struggling against Boston.

The criticism became even harsher as fans questioned whether the reaction was an attempt to influence the officials in a game that many believed was already slipping away from the 76ers . Others went as far as suggesting that James should consider retirement, while sarcastic comments about the supposed severity of the contact continued to circulate online.

A difficult night for Philadelphia

The incident added another negative moment to an evening in which James struggled to make an impact. He finished with 11 points, eight rebounds and five assists, shooting just four of his 12 attempts from the field. Meanwhile, Paul George delivered a much stronger performance for Philadelphia's opponents, putting up 36 points to help Boston secure a comfortable victory.

The social media reaction became another distraction for the 76ers, who could not keep up with the Celtics throughout the game. Instead of focusing exclusively on the result, much of the conversation surrounding James centered on his response to the contact and the decision to remain on the court.

Fans question the contrast in LeBron's attitude

The sarcastic reactions continued, with some supporters even joking that the seriousness of the apparent injury could keep him out of Philadelphia's next game . Although the comments were largely mocking, they showed how quickly the incident turned into another source of criticism for the four-time NBA champion.

The defeat left the 76ers with a 9-3 record, while the Celtics improved to 9-2 . Philadelphia still has work to do to maintain its position, and James will need to find a way to contribute more consistently as the team looks to keep improving its record. His performance against Boston was already a difficult one, but the viral incident ensured that his night would be remembered for reasons beyond the final score.

articles.title: “Nepotism is real”: The harsh truth about Bronny James’ Lakers future after LeBron’s departure
articles.standfirst: Kenyon Martin has delivered a candid assessment of Bronny's development
articles.summary: Kenyon Martin has delivered a candid assessment of Bronny's development
articles.body:
The departure of LeBron James from the Los Angeles Lakers has placed his son Bronny James in an unfamiliar position, with the 22-year-old now facing increased scrutiny over whether he can establish an NBA career without his father's presence.

LeBron 's move to the Philadelphia 76ers ahead of the 2026-27 season ended the historic father-son partnership that helped define Bronny 's arrival in Los Angeles. However, the younger James has struggled to secure meaningful playing time, raising questions about his long-term future.

Former NBA All-Star Kenyon Martin believes the situation reflects a problem that began well before LeBron left the franchise. While acknowledging that family connections helped Bronny reach the NBA, Martin suggested the guard would have benefited from spending more time developing in college.

Speaking during a conversation with Alejandro G , Martin argued that using personal influence to help a child succeed was understandable, even if it raised legitimate questions about whether Bronny had earned his opportunity.

“Wholeheartedly, and nepotism is real, right? We all know it, and we all would do it, 1,000%. If any one of us are able to put our child in a position to succeed and have direct influence on it, we would, right? No doubt about it,” Martin said.

Bronny entered the league as the 55th overall selection in the 2024 NBA Draft following one season at USC, where his development had been disrupted by a cardiac arrest in July 2023.

Martin believes that interruption made the transition particularly challenging, especially considering the expectations surrounding the son of one of basketball's greatest players.

“I just think it was a lot for the kid to deal with, considering everything he had dealt with at USC,” Martin explained.

Rather than criticizing Bronny personally, Martin argued that the circumstances surrounding his selection placed unnecessary pressure on a player who was still developing his skills.

“It was unfair to him. We get it, the last name is James, but it’s unfair to the kid. He’s still a kid,” he added.

Martin 's perspective carries personal significance, with his own son, Kenyon Martin Jr. , having entered the league as the 52nd overall pick in 2020.

Bronny faces uncertain future

The challenge facing Bronny has become clearer this season, with the young guard averaging just 0.8 points in 2.4 minutes across his first five appearances for Los Angeles.

However, a recent assignment to the Coachella Valley Lakers provided encouragement when he recorded 22 points and seven assists against the Salt Lake City Stars , demonstrating his ability to contribute when given extended playing time.

Those performances have yet to translate into a consistent NBA role, leaving the Lakers with an important developmental decision as Bronny continues his third professional season.

Martin nevertheless believes the opportunity itself should not define the young guard's career, regardless of whether he eventually establishes himself in the league.

“If it works, it works. If it doesn’t, you pivot,” Martin said.

With LeBron now in Philadelphia, Bronny 's challenge is no longer sharing the court with his father but proving he can earn a meaningful place in Los Angeles on his own terms.

articles.standfirst: The 19-year-old delivered an impressive block during Arizona's victory over Northern Arizona
articles.summary: The 19-year-old delivered an impressive block during Arizona's victory over Northern Arizona
articles.body:
A spectacular defensive play from Bryce James has given LeBron James another reason to celebrate his youngest son's basketball development, with the 19-year-old producing a viral moment during Arizona 's emphatic victory over Northern Arizona .

Bryce delivered an impressive block at the rim as the Arizona Wildcats secured a 90-59 win on Tuesday, providing a glimpse of the athletic ability that has surrounded his basketball career with considerable attention.

The young guard finished with three points, two assists, two steals and a block in 13 minutes. Although his offensive contribution was modest, his defensive performance offered encouragement as he attempts to establish himself in coach Tommy Lloyd 's rotation.

LeBron , who now plays for the Philadelphia 76ers , shared footage of the block on Instagram before posting additional highlights from his son's performance, accompanied by a message celebrating his progress.

“Bryce James is starting to understand it now. 1% each day Young (king)!” LeBron wrote.

The reaction highlighted the importance of gradual improvement for Bryce, whose college career has developed at a considerably different pace from that of his older brother, Bronny James .

While Bronny entered the NBA after one season at USC, Bryce has taken a more measured approach, spending his first year with Arizona developing without appearing in regular-season games.

During that campaign, the Wildcats won both the Big 12 regular-season and tournament championships before reaching the Final Four, giving Bryce an opportunity to experience a successful college program without immediately carrying significant playing responsibilities.

Now a redshirt freshman, Bryce is beginning to receive opportunities under Lloyd , although his involvement remains limited. Through three appearances, he is averaging 2.7 points and 1.7 assists as he adjusts to competitive college basketball.

His performance against Northern Arizona was particularly encouraging because of his defensive contributions, with the block and two steals demonstrating how he might earn additional minutes without becoming a major offensive option.

The 6-foot-5 guard has shown flashes of similar ability before, including a memorable chase-down block during his time at Sierra Canyon that drew comparisons with his father's trademark defensive plays.

Bryce 's breakthrough moment arrived on an otherwise disappointing evening for LeBron , whose Philadelphia team suffered a 123-101 defeat against the Boston Celtics .

LeBron has repeatedly emphasized the importance of making small improvements, previously sharing similar messages when Bryce 's high school highlights attracted attention.

That philosophy appears particularly relevant now that Bryce is competing for minutes within an established Arizona program rather than attempting to accelerate his journey towards the NBA.

His immediate challenge is earning the trust of Lloyd and becoming a dependable contributor as the Wildcats progress through their schedule.

The viral block may represent only one moment in a lengthy college season, but LeBron 's reaction suggests he values the progress behind it as much as the highlight itself.

articles.title: Stephen Curry injury update: Warriors guard ruled out for rest of game as concerns grow
articles.standfirst: The Warriors received a concerning update on Stephen Curry after the superstar guard exited Wednesday’s game with an apparent injury.
articles.summary: The Warriors received a concerning update on Stephen Curry after the superstar guard exited Wednesday’s game with an apparent injury.
articles.body:
The Golden State Warriors ’ eight-game winning streak took a back seat on Wednesday night when Stephen Curry was forced to leave the game against the Houston Rockets in the first quarter with an apparent right hip injury.

The star point guard showed discomfort after making a three-pointer and was seen holding his right side before heading to the locker room with 6:25 remaining in the first period, when Golden State trailed 19-10.

Brandin Podziemski entered in Curry’s place as the two-time NBA MVP left the court accompanied by Warriors head athletic trainer Drew Yoder.

ESPN showed footage of Curry walking toward the locker room and reported that the issue appeared to involve his right hip.

Curry played just five minutes and 35 seconds , finishing with three points on 1-of-3 shooting, including one three-pointer.

Curry’s injury raises concern for a surging Warriors team

The veteran’s exit came after he displayed discomfort in the right hip and oblique area during the early minutes of the game.

The injury arrives at a complicated time for a Warriors team that had become one of the hottest in the NBA.

Golden State entered the game at 8-3 after winning eight straight following an 0-3 start to the season .

Curry has been the primary engine of that turnaround. The 38-year-old entered the matchup against Houston as the team’s offensive leader, averaging 30.6 points , 4.3 assists , and 4.1 rebounds across nine games.

He was also connecting on 4.7 threes per game at a 45.7% clip from beyond the arc .

A prolonged absence would represent a significant blow for head coach Steve Kerr , as Curry is the player responsible for setting the offensive tempo and creating spacing that few others in the NBA can generate.

Warriors already dealing with injuries

The Warriors were already facing several physical issues before the Houston game.

Jimmy Butler remains out after undergoing ACL surgery , while Moses Moody continues recovering from a left patellar tendon procedure.

Kristaps Porzingis was also unavailable, as was Brandon Williams , who is dealing with a left hamstring injury.

Gary Payton II missed the game due to left knee inflammation, further thinning the perimeter options.

Will Richard was listed as probable despite a left thumb ligament injury.

These absences have forced Kerr to increase the responsibility of players such as Podziemski, De’Anthony Melton, and rookie Yaxel Lendeborg , who entered the game averaging 21.4 points, 7.2 rebounds, and four assists.

Replacing Curry’s production and influence, however, would be an entirely different challenge.

Golden State will continue its five-game road trip on Friday, November 13 , against the San Antonio Spurs , but the biggest question mark remains the status of its biggest star.

The Warriors have not yet confirmed whether the hip injury could affect Curry’s availability for upcoming games.

articles.title: Luka Doncic’s honest message after painful ankle scare
articles.standfirst: Luka Doncic’s night nearly ended in disaster after a scary ankle twist.
articles.summary: Luka Doncic’s night nearly ended in disaster after a scary ankle twist.
articles.body:
With the Los Angeles Lakers leading the Milwaukee Bucks by 21 points (111-90) in the fourth quarter, head coach JJ Redick decided to keep Luka Doncic on the floor to close out the victory. The decision, however, nearly turned into a problem for Los Angeles.

Doncic isolated against Kyle Kuzma and hit a step-back jumper, but as he landed he accidentally stepped on the Bucks player’s shoe, causing an ankle twist .

The Slovenian star remained on the floor for a few moments and showed clear signs of pain before getting up. Fortunately for the Lakers, early indications are that the incident will not have major consequences.

Doncic said after the game that he is “fine” — a positive sign as Los Angeles continues its four-game road trip. Redick backed up his player’s assessment, stating that Doncic “will be fine” and explaining that he suffered only a “mild ankle sprain.”

Before the scare, Doncic had turned in a strong performance against Milwaukee. The guard finished with 32 points , five rebounds , and five assists in 32 minutes while shooting 10-of-25 from the field.

The Lakers remain undefeated on their current road trip, which concludes Sunday against the Phoenix Suns . The team will have three full days of rest before tipping off again — a window that could prove key for Doncic to recover fully.

Still, Los Angeles will need to handle the situation carefully given the Slovenian’s history of lower-body issues.

In addition, with Austin Reaves dealing with a heel injury, the downtime comes at an ideal moment for the Lakers. The franchise has worked to keep at least one of its two primary perimeter stars available for every game, and after receiving positive updates on both players, early signs suggest they could both be ready to face the Suns.

articles.title: Have they apologized yet? Steph Curry lashes out at Gilbert Arenas and Nick Young in defense of his wife Ayesha
articles.standfirst: The Warriors superstar publicly challenged the former NBA players over their criticism of Ayesha's acting career, prompting both men to respond with apologies and explanations
articles.summary: The Warriors superstar publicly challenged the former NBA players over their criticism of Ayesha's acting career, prompting both men to respond with apologies and explanations
articles.body:
Stephen Curry has made it clear that criticism of his wife's professional choices is something he is no longer prepared to ignore.

After Gilbert Arenas and Nick Young questioned Ayesha Curry 's role in a new romantic comedy, the Golden State Warriors star addressed the comments directly, and the response was followed by apologies from both former players.

The disagreement began after Ayesha appeared in Second Chance Holiday, a Roku Channel movie released on November 5. The film features her alongside actor Matthew Daddario , with an on-screen kissing scene becoming a major talking point on social media.

Rather than focusing on her first leading role in a feature film, several commentators questioned why a married woman would participate in a romantic scene with another man.

Arenas was particularly critical during a discussion on the "We Said What We Said" podcast, describing Ayesha as the "only blemish" in an otherwise seemingly perfect Curry family. He also suggested that she did not behave like the wives of other prominent NBA stars, pointing to figures such as Savannah James and Cookie Johnson as examples.

Young, who previously played alongside Stephen in Golden State, also joined the discussion. Their remarks helped turn Ayesha's acting role into a wider debate about marriage, public image and the expectations placed on professional athletes' partners.

Stephen eventually decided to respond publicly. In a video shared on social media on Wednesday, November 11, he named Arenas, Young and former NFL player Emmanuel Acho among those whose comments had crossed a line.

"Something needs to be said," Curry declared, explaining that he had initially attempted to laugh off the criticism.

He accused the commentators of trying to undermine his wife's achievements and questioned their understanding of the acting profession.

He also challenged the broader attitudes behind the criticism, asking what women should be allowed to do while maintaining their own identities and careers.

Nick Young apologizes while Arenas attempts to explain his remarks

Curry's message did not go unanswered for long. Young and Arenas addressed the situation during a subsequent appearance on Gil's Arena, where both responded to the Warriors star.

Young was particularly direct in expressing regret, making it clear that he did not want his comments to damage his relationship with his former teammate.

"I'm sorry, Steph. You my dog. I love you. If I offended you, I apologize like a man. I'm sorry,” Young said.

Arenas also offered an apology, although he spent more time explaining what he had intended with his original comments. He argued that his description of Ayesha as a blemish was connected to how he viewed Stephen's public image, rather than an attempt to attack the couple's marriage.

"I'm sorry if he's offended. I didn't mean it like that. I was just saying he's such a perfect dude. But I'm sorry if he's offended," Arenas said.

The responses mean both former NBA players have now publicly apologized to Stephen, although their explanations differed in tone. There has been no comparable apology reported from Acho in connection with the comments.

Ayesha had already addressed the online reaction herself, dismissing the criticism surrounding the kissing scene. She previously wrote: "It's not even real 🤣 you guys are annoying."

The film marks an important step in her entertainment career. Beyond her work as an actress, Ayesha has established herself as a cookbook author, entrepreneur and television personality.

Stephen also used his response to turn the controversy into publicity for the project, thanking the critics for drawing attention to the movie and encouraging people to watch it on Roku .

The episode has therefore become about more than one scene in a holiday film. For Stephen, the central issue was the decision to judge his wife's career and personal choices.

And while Arenas and Young have now apologized, the discussion has highlighted the scrutiny Ayesha continues to face as she pursues opportunities outside her husband's basketball career.

articles.title: Steph Curry Injury Report: Great concern for the Warriors with the four-time NBA champion suffering an abdominal injury
articles.standfirst: Golden State's impressive winning run has come to an abrupt end, but the bigger worry is the condition of its superstar, who left the defeat against Houston early and was sent for an MRI
articles.summary: Golden State's impressive winning run has come to an abrupt end, but the bigger worry is the condition of its superstar, who left the defeat against Houston early and was sent for an MRI
articles.body:
The Golden State Warriors are waiting for answers about Stephen Curry 's fitness after the four-time NBA champion suffered a right abdominal injury during Wednesday night's 115-108 defeat to the Houston Rockets .

Head coach Steve Kerr admitted that concern was high after the 38-year-old reported an unfamiliar problem in his abdominal area. Curry underwent an MRI during the second half, although the Warriors had not received the results when Kerr spoke to reporters after the game.

The injury happened early in the first quarter. Curry had just connected on a three-pointer, which proved to be his only basket of the night, when he appeared to experience discomfort on his right side. He put his hand against the area and visibly winced as he moved back down the court.

Rather than attempting to continue, the two-time NBA MVP approached Kerr before heading to the locker room. He did not return, and the Warriors subsequently confirmed that he had been ruled out for the remainder of the contest with right abdominal soreness.

"He said he tweaked something in his abdominal area and said he's never done it before," Kerr said post-match.

The coach offered little reassurance when asked how worried the organization was about its leading player: "Concern is high, but I have no idea the extent of the injury."

Kerr also confirmed that Curry had left the arena during the second half to undergo further examination. Until the medical results become available, there is no confirmed diagnosis or timetable for his return.

Why Curry's absence could be a major setback for Golden State

The timing is particularly frustrating for a Warriors team that had finally found its rhythm after a difficult opening to the campaign.

Golden State began the season with three consecutive defeats but responded by putting together an eight-game winning streak. Curry was central to that turnaround, finishing as the team's leading scorer in six of those victories.

His individual performances had also been impressive. Entering the Houston matchup, he was averaging 30.6 points per game, placing him second in the NBA scoring rankings.

The 12-time All-Star had become the driving force behind Golden State's offensive production, making his availability especially important as the team looks to maintain its position in the Western Conference.

Houston took advantage of his early departure, with Kevin Durant scoring 20 points and Alperen Sengun and Amen Thompson contributing 19 apiece. The Rockets eventually secured a seven-point victory, ending the Warriors' eight-game run.

Golden State still found contributions elsewhere. Rookie Yaxel Lendeborg finished with 25 points and 10 rebounds, while Brandin Podziemski added 22 points. However, replacing Curry's scoring and influence over an entire game remains a considerable challenge.

The Warriors now face an anxious wait for the MRI findings before making decisions about their star's availability for upcoming games.

Curry has previously dealt with injuries that have interrupted his seasons, making the latest setback another concern for the organization.

For now, there is no confirmation that he will miss an extended period. The immediate priority is establishing exactly what happened to his abdominal area and whether the problem will require time away from the court.

Until those answers arrive, Golden State will have to prepare for the possibility of playing without its most important offensive player.

articles.title: Stephen Curry sells $11 million property after failed business dream, but the new owner has problems of its own
articles.standfirst: After generating tens of millions of dollars with the Golden State Warriors, Stephen Curry set out to expand his business ventures in San Francisco. But a conflict ended up changing his plans, and the outcome was a multimillion-dollar sale.
articles.summary: After generating tens of millions of dollars with the Golden State Warriors, Stephen Curry set out to expand his business ventures in San Francisco. But a conflict ended up changing his plans, and the outcome was a multimillion-dollar sale.
articles.body:
Stephen Curry made an unexpected real estate move in San Francisco. The Golden State Warriors player sold for $11 million a building he had purchased in 2024 for $8.5 million, in a deal that ended up being favorable even though his original plan never came to fruition.

The property was intended to become the new headquarters of Thirty Ink, the company that brings together much of his business outside of basketball. However, a conflict related to the hiring of unionized workers ended up derailing the development. Now, the property has a new owner and a connection to the world of artificial intelligence.

Stephen Curry's multimillion-dollar project that never came to fruition

The building is located in the Dogpatch neighborhood, near the Pier 70 waterfront area and approximately half a kilometer from the Chase Center , the arena where Golden State plays. Curry had bought it for $8.5 million in 2024 with the intention of turning it into an ambitious business center.

The plans called for a five-story, roughly 25,000-square-foot building, with offices, laboratories, spaces for artistic activities, a community area, and a terrace. It was even planned to include a three-bedroom penthouse to host the company's partners and visitors.

The conflict that forced Curry to change his plans

The initiative was canceled in April 2025 , after Thirty Ink failed to reach an agreement with the carpenters' union on working conditions and the use of unionized workers during construction.

The company had proposed using union labor for 40% of the project, but the negotiations were unsuccessful . Despite attempts by local authorities to keep the initiative alive, the plan was ultimately scrapped and Curry decided to part with the property.

The unexpected buyer of the $11 million building

The property was acquired by Dane Reinsurance Inc., a company registered in Utah that has ties to Corgi , a startup related to the insurance and artificial intelligence sector.

The deal represents a $2.5 million difference between the purchase and sale prices for Curry, although that figure does not include taxes, commissions, or other expenses associated with the transaction

The new owner is also facing difficulties in its business operations. Corgi, the startup linked to the company that acquired the property, had to put part of its expansion plans on hold after facing problems with the authorities in San Francisco , including questions over permits and sanitary conditions at some of its establishments.

The company had planned to open 100 coffee shops in just six months, but ended up pausing new lease agreements and reducing part of its team. Thus, the building that Stephen Curry sold for $11 million ended up in the hands of a company whose ambitious growth is running into some obstacles.

articles.title: Emmanuel Acho retracts comments about Ayesha Curry and apologizes to her husband, Steph
articles.standfirst: The Warriors superstar demanded accountability after criticism of his wife's acting performance
articles.summary: The Warriors superstar demanded accountability after criticism of his wife's acting performance
articles.body:
Stephen Curry has received a public apology from Emmanuel Acho after confronting several prominent sports commentators over their criticism of his wife, Ayesha Curry , whose appearance in a new romantic comedy became the subject of an unexpected debate.

The Golden State Warriors guard broke his usual silence on criticism involving his family after former athletes questioned Ayesha's decision to participate in a kissing scene with actor Matthew Daddario in Roku's Second Chance Holiday, released on November 5.

Among those discussing the performance were former NFL players LeSean McCoy and Acho , who examined the scene during an episode of the Speakeasy podcast. Their conversation attracted attention as Curry questioned why his wife's professional acting work had become a subject of public criticism.

Rather than dismissing the remarks, the four-time NBA champion directly addressed the commentators, arguing that their reactions reflected a broader problem with how women are treated when pursuing opportunities outside their personal relationships.

“Nick [Young], Gil [Arenas], Emmanuel [Acho] and anybody else who feels the need to jump in and give an opinion on something you don’t really know about,” Curry said.

"Something that kinda speaks to a bigger conversation on how you view women in this world and what they’re allowed and not allowed to do."

Acho apologizes after Steph challenges critics

The controversy began when McCoy expressed frustration over the romantic scene, questioning why Ayesha would participate in an on-screen kiss given her marriage to one of basketball's most recognizable players.

“This is crazy,” McCoy said during the podcast. “I’ve seen a while ago where she keeps saying how she wants more attention, and how girls throw themselves at him and she still just wants to feel like she’s wanted… now you want us to see kissing a dude?… This is crazy.”

Acho subsequently joined the discussion, suggesting that the camera angle might have made the scene appear more intimate than it actually was.

“You see the way they shot it? Nah, that might be on the chin; you look at the angle,” he remarked. “It’s on the chin.”

However, after Curry responded publicly, Acho acknowledged the concerns raised by the Warriors star and offered an apology rather than defending his earlier comments.

“When a man humbly comes to you and requests an apology, then you wouldn’t be ignorant to respond with anything else than I’m sorry,” Acho said on Speakeasy.

Steph demands respect for Ayesha's acting career

Curry 's criticism extended beyond Acho , with former NBA players Gilbert Arenas and Nick Young also named in his response to the attention surrounding his wife's performance.

“I tried to laugh this one off, but something needs to be said,” Curry explained, urging commentators to recognize Ayesha's professional achievement instead of creating controversy around her marriage.

Acho responded directly to Curry 's concerns, acknowledging that the discussion may have affected both the player and his wife.

“Steph, I’m sorry for not just offending you but potentially offending your wife. I’m sorry for how it may have made you feel,” he said.

The apology represents a significant change in tone following Curry 's intervention, although it remains unclear whether the other commentators will publicly address his criticism.

For Curry , the dispute was never simply about a movie scene, but about allowing Ayesha to pursue her own career without having her professional decisions judged through the expectations surrounding their marriage.

articles.title: Khloé Kardashian: "To me, Lamar Odom is dead, all men are liars"
articles.standfirst: Khloé Kardashian burns bridges with Lamar Odom, harshly attacking the man who was once her husband
articles.summary: Khloé Kardashian burns bridges with Lamar Odom, harshly attacking the man who was once her husband
articles.body:
Khloé Kardashian is definitively severing her ties with her ex-husband Lamar Odom, who in the past confessed "I have spent more than 100 million dollars on drugs" and his addiction to women ("I'm a sex addict, I've been with more than 2,000 women" ) .

There are many things that I have found truly distasteful

"I watched the Netflix documentary about Lamar ("Untold: The Death & Life of Lamar Odom"). It doesn’t amuse me at all. While I was watching it, I thought: "Wait a second, I’ve spent some of my time sitting here to do you a favor. I’m not getting paid; I’m doing it simply to be kind". And there are many things that I found really in poor taste", Kim Kardashian’s sister commented on the reality show "The Kardashians" on Hulu .

The documentary recounts the tragedies and difficulties that the former NBA player has faced in his 47 years of life, including his divorce from Kardashian in 2016 and the near-death experience he went through in 2015 after suffering an overdose in a brothel.

You say that in reality you were never in love with me, that you married me only to gain more popularity in pop culture... all that kind of thing, which is very strange

"There was a time when Khloé Kardashian practically had to spoon-feed Lamar Odom to bring him back to life and help him go to the bathroom," says Scott Disick , Kourtney Kardashian's ex-partner.

This only confirms that men are liars, scammers, cheaters, thieves, and trolls. And, quite simply, I want nothing to do with that. Play with yourself, but not with me

Odom claims to have suffered 12 strokes and six heart attacks, managing to defy the medical predictions that indicated he would never walk or speak again.

The Kardashian clan member also revealed on "The Kardashians" that she contracted a staph infection after having "lived in a hospital for four months."

Khloé Kardashian: "I don't need you to thank me, Lamar Odom. Just don't talk about me"

Khloé Kardashian did not hesitate to directly attack the former Baskonia, Lakers, Clippers, Heat and Mavericks player: "You say that you weren't really in love with me, that you married me only to gain more popularity in pop culture... all that kind of thing, which is very strange. Even if that is your truth, why not say it without me being present in these interviews? I found it really regrettable".

I don't need you to thank me, Lamar Odom. Just don't talk about me. Don't try to discredit me," she shared, later stating that "the bridge has been destroyed and there's no rope left to throw to the other side. So, to me, he is dead.

When a producer tried to comfort her, Khloé Kardashian unleashed: "It's okay. I think this only confirms that men are liars, scammers, cheaters, thieves, and trolls. And, quite simply, I don't want anything to do with that. Play with yourself, but not with me."

Lamar Odom: "I wouldn't change my time with Khloé Kardashian, I would only change my actions"

Lamar Odom and Khloé Kardashian got married in 2009 after a courtship of just 30 years .

"It’s a stage I wouldn’t change. The only thing I would probably change would be my actions. But it was part of my story, part of my life; that’s not going to disappear. The only thing I can do now is try to be the best man possible: for myself, for my children (Destiny and Lamar Odom Jr., whom he had with his former fiancée Liza Morales) and for my family," the former player pointed out.

articles.title: NBA Europe advances and predicts franchises worth up to 1 billion: "It will drive incredible investments"
articles.standfirst: Mark Tatum, the NBA's number two, defends the economic potential of NBA Europe and backs a 16-team league with four spots open based on sporting merit.
articles.summary: Mark Tatum, the NBA's number two, defends the economic potential of NBA Europe and backs a 16-team league with four spots open based on sporting merit.
articles.body:
The NBA continues taking steps to establish itself in European basketball, and Mark Tatum , deputy commissioner of the North American league and right-hand man to Adam Silve r, has once again made clear the ambitions of the NBA Europe project, which would arrive on the Old Continent hand in hand with FIBA .

During his speech at the Invest New York event, organized by Sportico, the executive addressed some of the economic and sporting keys to the future competition , which aims to transform the ecosystem of continental basketball and compete directly with the EuroLeague.

The teams that are part of the current ecosystem are, frankly, tired of investing tens of millions of dollars every year without seeing the value of their franchises increase

One of the NBA's main arguments is the economic potential it considers untapped in Europe . Tatum believes there is a huge gap between basketball's popularity, the talent of its players, and the revenue it generates compared with other sports. According to the executive, this situation is causing growing discontent among the owners of Europe's leading clubs.

"The launch of NBA Europe will drive incredible investment in infrastructure

"The teams that are part of the current ecosystem are, frankly, tired of investing tens of millions of dollars every year without seeing the value of their franchises increase. They are looking for a new economic partner," Tatum said.

Franchises worth up to $1 billion in NBA Europe

The NBA maintains its ambition to attract major investments through a franchise model that would allow it to develop new markets and multiply the value of the participating clubs. Tatum expressed confidence that the most valuable franchises in NBA Europe could reach valuations close to $1 billion , a figure that reflects the economic scale of the project.

Expansion into markets with high commercial potential, such as the United Kingdom, currently outside the EuroLeague, is another of the competition's major bets. In addition, another important factor relating to the economic side is the plan for distributing profits and rights to all participating teams.

The teams in the current ecosystem are looking for a new financial partner

The plan also envisages significant investments in sports infrastructure, one of the main shortcomings that the NBA identifies in European basketball. The construction and modernization of arenas capable of hosting major sporting and entertainment events would make it possible to develop new sources of revenue.

"The launch of this league will drive incredible investments in infrastructure. Let's imagine there are between 30 and 40 home basketball nights. That leaves another 320 days to fill those venues with music, concerts, conferences, and other kinds of events," he explained.

The NBA's barb at the EuroLeague: "In essence, it is a closed league"

Beyond economic issues, Tatum also questioned the current functioning of European basketball , marked by the coexistence of the EuroLeague, the Basketball Champions League, the EuroCup and the different national competitions. In the executive's view, this fragmentation creates a complex and poorly connected landscape.

articles.title: The viral story of the boy who was named after the Knicks title
articles.standfirst: The special meaning behind a baby name inspired by the Knicks' championship
articles.summary: The special meaning behind a baby name inspired by the Knicks' championship
articles.body:
A New York couple has found a memorable way to celebrate the Knicks ’ championship success: by giving their newborn son a name inspired by the team's famous victory chant.

Yvonne Gonzalez-Bradford and her husband, Vance Bradford , welcomed a baby boy named Knickson Fyve Bradford after the Knicks captured the 2026 NBA title . Their unusual naming decision has since attracted attention from basketball fans across the country.

When New York defeated the San Antonio Spurs in Game 5 of the Finals on June 13, ending a 53-year championship drought, celebrations erupted throughout the city. The expectant couple could hear neighbors shouting “Knicks in five,” a phrase that quickly became a rallying cry for supporters.

Yvonne , who was pregnant at the time, suddenly wondered whether those celebrations could inspire her baby's name. She suggested “Knickson” to her husband, who immediately embraced the idea. It was an opportunity for the couple to connect their growing family with a historic moment that meant so much to New York.

“It was in that moment that I was like, ‘Oh, my God, is this just my hormones? Would it be crazy if we named the baby Knickson after the Knicks and this win right now?’” said Yvonne.

The middle name came a little later and carried an additional personal connection for his father.

A name with meaning beyond basketball

Yvonne suggested spelling the number as “Fyve,” completing the reference to the Knicks' five-game Finals triumph. Vance also goes by “V,” the Roman numeral for five, giving the middle name a special connection between father and son.

“My nickname, a lot of people call me V. The Roman numeral for five is V,” said Vance . “So I didn’t get a junior, and I didn’t want a junior, but I do want to have some connection to him in my name, so there it is.”

The Bradfords hope their son's name will remind him to remain determined, overcome challenges and keep pushing forward whenever life becomes difficult.

Yvonne believes the Knicks' journey provides an excellent example of perseverance and resilience. She wants to teach her son about the team's determination and how refusing to give up can eventually lead to success.

“We can talk to him about that perseverance, about keep on going on,” she said.

“It’s such an impactful name. It’s just legendary at this point. [I’m] proud that he can align with New York in that moment and that’s what we can teach him.”

The team's achievement made the naming decision even more special. New York defeated San Antonio 94-90 in the deciding game, with Jalen Brunson scoring 45 points, to secure its first NBA championship since 1973.

After the couple shared their first pictures of Knickson on Instagram, their announcement quickly gained traction online. Basketball supporters and media outlets embraced the newborn, with some affectionately giving him the nickname “the City's nephew.”

Yvonne admitted that seeing so many strangers celebrate her son was an emotional experience. Messages of encouragement, blessings and positive wishes poured in, making the moment even more memorable for the first-time parents.

Vance is particularly excited about showing Knickson the photographs and messages when he's older. He hopes his son will understand how a historic sporting achievement became part of his identity.
